papers.title: TimeArch: A Multi-Agent Approach for Software Architecture Design
papers.abstract: Generative AI is making software implementation faster, but not necessarily better architected. Most current GenAI coding workflows move directly from prompts to code, while the architectural reasoning that should connect requirements, quality attributes, stakeholders, design decisions, and implementation remains weakly supported. Architectural styles, system decomposition, tradeoff analysis, quality-attribute decisions, and stakeholder concerns are often left implicit or handled outside the AI-supported workflow. This creates a missing architectural layer between requirements and code, limiting traceability, validation, and governance in GenAI-enabled software development. This paper presents TimeArch, a multi-agent approach that makes this architectural layer explicit. TimeArch structures software architecture design as a governed lifecycle rather than a one-shot generation task. It combines agent-based reasoning with retrieval-augmented grounding to support requirement definition, architecture design, validation and assurance, and delivery and evolution. The approach supports requirement capture, architectural driver identification, design reasoning, validation, and decision documentation within a traceable process. We demonstrate TimeArch through a working prototype that operationalizes the proposed approach and assess its feasibility using representative software architecture design cases from multiple domains with heterogeneous inputs. As future work, we plan to conduct comprehensive industrial case studies to evaluate the adoption and use of TimeArch in both new and existing software projects. A TimeArch demo is available at: this https URL. Keywords: AI-native software architecture; requirements-driven software architecture; architectural reasoning; architecture traceability; architecture validation

translation.title: TimeArch：一种用于软件架构设计的多智能体方法
translation.abstract: 生成式AI正在使软件实现变得更快，但不一定带来更好的架构。当前大多数GenAI编码工作流直接从提示词跳到代码，而本应连接需求、质量属性、利益相关者、设计决策与实现的架构推理仍然缺乏充分支持。架构风格、系统分解、权衡分析、质量属性决策和利益相关者关注点往往被隐式处理或在AI支持的工作流之外处理。这在需求与代码之间造成了一个缺失的架构层，限制了GenAI赋能的软件开发中的可追溯性、验证与治理。本文提出TimeArch，一种使该架构层显式化的多智能体方法。TimeArch将软件架构设计构建为一个受治理的生命周期，而非一次性生成任务。它将基于智能体的推理与检索增强的接地相结合，支持需求定义、架构设计、验证与保障、交付与演化。该方法在一个可追溯的流程中支持需求捕获、架构驱动因素识别、设计推理、验证和决策文档化。我们通过一个可运行的原型来演示TimeArch，该原型实现了所提出的方法，并使用来自多个领域、具有异构输入的代表性软件架构设计案例评估其可行性。作为未来工作，我们计划开展全面的工业案例研究，以评估TimeArch在新项目和现有项目中的采用与使用情况。TimeArch演示可访问：this https URL。关键词：AI原生软件架构；需求驱动的软件架构；架构推理；架构可追溯性；架构验证
translation.brief: 针对GenAI编码工作流中需求与代码之间缺失架构层的问题，提出TimeArch多智能体方法，将架构设计构建为结合智能体推理与检索增强接地的受治理生命周期。

papers.title: Towards Comprehensive Mobile Application Testing for User-centric Feature Coverage via Simulating Real-World Users with Personas
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for black-box mobile application testing, where the ultimate goal is the comprehensive coverage of the features users rely on. However, most existing studies focus on Activity Coverage, which measures the proportion of distinct application screens visited during a test session but does not directly measure whether agents actually test the features users care about. To address this, we focus on (1) how to automatically measure whether a testing framework covers the features users care about, and (2) how to design a framework that achieves more comprehensive feature coverage. To answer (1), we introduce the User-Centric Feature Coverage benchmark, which consists of two components: a manually crafted dataset of 3,012 user-centric target features based on real reviews and app descriptions, and an automated evaluation pipeline that translates agent-generated test cases and target features into a shared semantic space, then uses an LLM-as-a-judge to compute coverage. To answer (2), we introduce ECS (Exploration, Critical User Journeys, and Synthetic Reviews). ECS is a framework that explores the application, then uses an LLM to convert exploration traces into Critical User Journeys (CUJs) to bring the semantic meaning of the trace closer to a distinct feature. Each CUJ consists of an LLM-inferred user intent paired with reproducible test steps. ECS then aggregates multiple CUJs using persona-augmented synthetic reviews to capture more complex features, simulating real users who build knowledge of an application across multiple screens before writing a review. ECS achieves 64.1% feature coverage, a 23.8% gain over the state-of-the-art baseline, and covers 72.5% of features in app descriptions, capturing the most prominent features. Our failure analysis shows statelessness and exploration discoverability as main reasons of failures, providing future directions.

translation.title: 通过Persona模拟真实用户实现以用户为中心的功能覆盖的全面移动应用测试
translation.abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地用于黑盒移动应用测试，其最终目标是全面覆盖用户所依赖的功能。然而，现有研究大多关注Activity Coverage，它衡量测试会话中访问的不同应用屏幕的比例，但并不能直接衡量智能体是否真正测试了用户关心的功能。为此，我们关注：(1) 如何自动衡量测试框架是否覆盖了用户关心的功能；(2) 如何设计一个实现更全面功能覆盖的框架。为回答(1)，我们提出User-Centric Feature Coverage基准，包含两个部分：基于真实评论和应用描述手工构建的3,012个以用户为中心的目标功能数据集，以及一个自动化评估流水线，该流水线将智能体生成的测试用例和目标功能转换到共享语义空间，然后使用LLM-as-a-judge计算覆盖率。为回答(2)，我们提出ECS（Exploration、Critical User Journeys和Synthetic Reviews）。ECS是一个框架，先探索应用，然后使用LLM将探索轨迹转换为Critical User Journeys（CUJ），使轨迹的语义更接近具体功能。每个CUJ由LLM推断的用户意图和可复现的测试步骤组成。ECS随后使用persona增强的合成评论聚合多个CUJ以捕获更复杂的功能，模拟那些在撰写评论前跨多个屏幕积累应用知识的真实用户。ECS实现了64.1%的功能覆盖率，比最先进的基线提升23.8%，并覆盖了应用描述中72.5%的功能，捕获了最突出的功能。我们的失败分析表明，无状态性和探索可发现性是失败的主要原因，为未来研究提供了方向。
translation.brief: 针对现有移动应用测试只衡量屏幕覆盖而非用户功能覆盖的问题，提出User-Centric Feature Coverage基准和ECS框架，通过探索轨迹转CUJ并结合persona合成评论来提升功能覆盖率。

papers.title: Replay Is a Family of Assertions: Fork-Safety in Event-Sourced Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract: Event-sourced agent runtimes commonly claim deterministic replay, cheap forking, and lineage. These are families of assertions, not one guarantee. A fixed-log fold may be deterministic while reactive settlement remains schedule-sensitive; a recorded oracle result can enable zero-call replay while the original interaction still changed cost or world state; and a prefix copy cannot undo an action in a discarded suffix. We present an executable F# contract that separates facts from effect requests, makes scheduling explicit, and assesses a cut relative to projection, strict execution replay, external continuation, or a declared counterfactual-world observation. Preserved counterexamples show that general settlement is neither terminating nor confluent and that disjoint declared writes do not prevent read/trigger interference. Against 5,540 public runtime logs, all 317,296 projection cuts satisfy the stated observation, while 36,251 cuts split a model request and do not license continuation; another 120,969 are Conditional because a committed oracle result must be served from the record without re-execution. In 121 observed forks, 16,625 retained-prefix events have zero structural mismatches, but none crosses an external-effect boundary. A separate public offline conformance fork crosses a committed, recorded oracle boundary. Its generator observes that the inherited result is served without a second fixture-oracle call; its verifier checks receipt/log consistency and a fork-bound HMAC assertion under a public conformance key. The result reframes cheap forking as a property-indexed semantic contract with explicit evidence and environment preconditions.

translation.title: 重放是一族断言：事件溯源智能体运行时中的分叉安全性
translation.abstract: 事件溯源的智能体运行时通常声称具有确定性重放、廉价分叉和谱系追踪能力。这些其实是一族断言，而非单一保证。固定日志的折叠可能是确定性的，而响应式结算仍对调度敏感；记录的oracle结果可以实现零调用重放，而原始交互仍改变了成本或世界状态；前缀复制无法撤销被丢弃后缀中的动作。我们提出一个可执行的F#契约，将事实与效果请求分离，使调度显式化，并相对于投影、严格执行重放、外部延续或声明的反事实世界观察来评估一个切分。保留的反例表明，一般性结算既不终止也不合流，且不相交的声明写入并不能防止读/触发干扰。针对5,540个公开运行时日志，所有317,296个投影切分均满足所述观察，而36,251个切分拆分了模型请求且不许可延续；另有120,969个是条件性的，因为已提交的oracle结果必须从记录中提供而无需重新执行。在121次观察到的分叉中，16,625个保留前缀事件没有结构性不匹配，但没有一个跨越外部效果边界。一个单独的公开离线一致性分叉跨越了已提交、已记录的oracle边界。其生成器观察到继承结果无需第二次fixture-oracle调用即可提供；其验证器在公开一致性密钥下检查回执/日志一致性和分叉边界HMAC断言。该结果将廉价分叉重新定义为具有显式证据和环境前提条件的属性索引语义契约。
translation.brief: 针对事件溯源智能体运行时将重放、分叉等混为一谈的问题，提出可执行的F#契约将事实与效果请求分离，把廉价分叉形式化为带显式证据的属性索引语义契约。

papers.title: Beyond the Agent Harness: Boundary Criteria for Software-Factory Orchestration - A Single-Operator Case Study
papers.abstract: Several recent systems add a layer above the coding-agent harness that organises many agent runs into continuous delivery. The existence of such a layer is not our contribution. What is missing is a rule for deciding which layer a mechanism or a failure belongs to. We propose boundary criteria based on an operational definition of a run. A mechanism confined to one run belongs to the agent harness. One that coordinates runs, hands state from one run to a later one, or is updated from run outcomes belongs to a factory harness. One that must change with the application domain belongs to the domain layer. Two residual tests assign infrastructure and model causes. For failures, we code where the defect originated, which control failed to stop it, and where it was fixed as three separate fields, and we require positive evidence before attributing a failure to the environment. We developed the criteria on documented failures from a single operator's pipeline serving six projects and on 26 components of three published systems. We then froze them and had two model coders of the same family apply them to the same descriptions of 46 held-out units. They agreed on all 26 mechanism layers and on 18-19 of 20 incident fields (kappa 0.86-0.93), but both coders recorded the incident as undetermined or unrecorded in 8-13 of the 20 cases per field, and each flagged half of all units as ambiguous, mostly for missing information. The check exposed conflicts in the rules; a revision that separates mechanism classification from incident attribution resolves them but, in a sensitivity re-coding, agreed less (kappa 0.78-0.93). Agreement here is neither accuracy nor usefulness, and human coders have not yet been tested. Case evidence and seven hypotheses are reported as preliminary.

translation.title: 超越智能体Harness：软件工厂编排的边界准则——单操作者案例研究
translation.abstract: 近期多个系统在编码智能体harness之上增加了一层，将大量智能体运行组织为持续交付。这一层的存在并非我们的贡献。缺失的是一条判定某个机制或故障属于哪一层的规则。我们基于对run的操作性定义提出边界准则。局限于单次run的机制属于agent harness；协调多次run、将状态从一次run传递给后续run、或根据run结果更新的机制属于factory harness；必须随应用领域变化的机制属于领域层。两个残余测试用于归因基础设施和模型原因。对于故障，我们将缺陷起源、哪个控制未能阻止它、以及在哪里修复编码为三个独立字段，并要求在将故障归因于环境之前必须有正面证据。我们基于单一操作者服务六个项目的流水线中记录的故障，以及三个已发表系统的26个组件开发了这些准则。随后我们冻结准则，让两个同族模型的编码者将其应用于46个保留单元的相同描述。他们在全部26个机制层上达成一致，在20个事件字段中的18-19个上达成一致（kappa 0.86-0.93），但两位编码者在每个字段的20个案例中有8-13个将事件记录为未确定或未记录，且各自将一半单元标记为含糊，主要因信息缺失。该检查暴露了规则中的冲突；将机制分类与事件归因分离的修订版解决了这些冲突，但在敏感性重编码中一致性较低（kappa 0.78-0.93）。这里的一致性既不等于准确性也不等于有用性，且尚未对人类编码者进行测试。案例证据和七个假设仅作为初步结果报告。
translation.brief: 针对软件工厂编排中机制与故障归属层级缺乏判定规则的问题，基于run的操作性定义提出边界准则，并通过双编码者实验检验其可靠性。

papers.title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.

translation.title: SteelAgent：LLM编排的、物理信息增强的钢性能预测，具备可审计泛化与校准不确定性
translation.abstract: 钢性能模型即使在随机测试划分上表现良好，也可能对陌生合金的外推能力很差。SteelAgent将冶金描述符和机器学习模型与语言模型接口相结合，用于性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计。我们考察了保留单元的选择如何改变从SteelBench抗拉强度评估中得出的结论。对于梯度提升，池化的折外$R^2$从随机划分下的0.859降至按钢族保留时的0.113。名义90%预测区间的经验覆盖率从随机划分下的91.0%降至按数据源保留时的37.6%。物理衍生特征的效果取决于评估方式：在17族保留分析中，它们使梯度提升$R^2$提高0.2534，而在另一项四牌号实验室分析中使其降低0.358。我们报告了组级误差和一个合成回归实验，说明校准如何在保留组上恶化。这些结果促使我们在报告性能估计或合规评分的同时报告评估总体。
translation.brief: 针对钢性能模型在随机划分上表现好但对陌生合金外推差的问题，提出SteelAgent将冶金描述符、机器学习与LLM接口结合，并强调按组评估泛化与不确定性校准。

papers.title: A Sharp Additive Bound for the Threshold Rule in Repeated Rent-or-Buy
papers.abstract: Motivated by context management in LLM agents, we study a repeated rent-or-buy model with schedule-independent history growth and a fixed reset price $K$, a discrete form of dynamic TCP acknowledgment: every call pays as rent the history accumulated since the last reset, and a reset clears it. The classical threshold rule is $2$-competitive, and no deterministic rule guarantees a smaller ratio. We show that, measured additively, its loss is governed by the changes in the growth: if the growth is constant on $P$ runs, the threshold rule, knowing neither the runs nor the horizon, pays at most $(2P-1)K$ more than the optimal schedule chosen with hindsight, and the coefficient $2P-1$ is sharp. If the growth is only within a factor $1+\varepsilon$ of $P$ runs, the bound holds up to a factor $1+\varepsilon$ and an extra $\varepsilon K$. The proof is a potential argument built from the relative value functions of the single-rate problems. On two runs no deterministic rule guarantees a loss below $2K$. A rule that also resets when the growth decreases guarantees $2K$, while the threshold rule can lose arbitrarily close to $3K$.

translation.title: 重复租买问题中阈值规则的紧致加性界
translation.abstract: 受 LLM 智能体上下文管理启发，我们研究具有与调度无关的历史增长和固定重置价格 $K$ 的重复租买模型，它是动态 TCP 确认的一种离散形式：每次调用需支付自上次重置以来累积历史的租金，重置则清空历史。经典阈值规则是 2-竞争的，且没有确定性规则能保证更小的比率。我们证明，以加性方式度量，其损失由增长的变化决定：若增长在 $P$ 段上为常数，则阈值规则在既不知道各段也不知道时域的情况下，比事后选择的最优调度至多多付 $(2P-1)K$，且系数 $2P-1$ 是紧的。若增长与 $P$ 段常数仅相差因子 $1+\varepsilon$，则该界在因子 $1+\varepsilon$ 和额外 $\varepsilon K$ 的范围内成立。证明基于单速率问题的相对值函数构造的势函数论证。在两段情形下，没有确定性规则能保证损失低于 $2K$。一个在增长下降时也进行重置的规则可保证 $2K$，而阈值规则的损失可任意接近 $3K$。
translation.brief: 研究带变化历史增长的重复租买问题，通过势函数论证为经典阈值规则给出紧致的加性竞争损失界。

papers.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL). We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards. Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.

translation.title: Octopus：面向潜在 KV 多智能体强化学习的单脑多分支架构
translation.abstract: 多智能体 LLM 系统通过生成具有隔离上下文窗口的子智能体进行并行探索，而单智能体系统则将每次搜索和验证步骤追加到一条不断增长的轨迹中。然而，现有多智能体框架在各分支间复制前缀 KV 缓存、通过重新预填充文本摘要交换发现结果，并在强化学习（RL）中扁平化或丢弃跨分支依赖。我们提出 Octopus，一个单模型多智能体 RL 框架，其中所有线程共享一个骨干网络，并通过五个原语（fork、read_thread、wait_threads、rewind、commit）在 GPU 驻留的 KV 状态有向无环图（DAG）上进行协调。Octopus 结合三个协同设计机制：(1) 零拷贝基数树分叉（Zero-Copy Radix Forking），以对共享物理 KV 页的 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 游标视图生成分支；(2) 仅注意力 KV 挂载（Attention-Only KV Mounting），将兄弟线程的末端 KV 块直接挂载到全注意力层，同时绕过线性递归状态（Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2），将任务外劫持降低 $21\times$（$57.9\% \to 2.7\%$），同时在零额外 KV 分配下保留 $92.2\%$ 的全文互信息；(3) 打包 DAG-GRPO 训练器，将所有回合分支打包进一次块稀疏注意力前向传播，并通过留一分支边际奖励分配反事实分支信用。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上基于稀疏 BM25 语料用 GRPO 端到端训练后，Octopus 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 $49.6\%$ 准确率（比 143K 上下文的单智能体 GRPO 高 $+17.5$ 分，比文本摘要多智能体 RL 高 $+12.5$ 分），在 OpenResearcher 上达到 $51.2\%$，超越规模大至 $250\times$ 的稠密检索智能体，同时训练吞吐量提升 $3.3\times$，峰值 KV 内存降低 $2.8\times$。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体 LLM 框架中 KV 缓存重复和跨分支信息丢失问题，提出共享单一骨干、通过 KV 状态 DAG 协调的多智能体强化学习框架 Octopus。

papers.title: Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation
papers.abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. Our experience is that the risks lie in the statements rather than in the proofs, and that simple automated tests on the statements can expose problems even in the established literature. We illustrate this with a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted. We invite the inverse problems community to extend and build on the library.

translation.title: AI 时代的反问题形式化：可能性、陷阱与一份邀请
translation.abstract: Lean 等证明助手可将数学证明检验至公理层面，而 AI 智能体近来使撰写此类证明变得廉价。我们介绍 AutoIP，一个 Lean 库，其中经典线性正则化理论及其依赖的泛函分析已由 AI 智能体自动形式化。机器检验的证明只认证其证明的形式化陈述，因此剩余的人类任务是确认每个形式化陈述表达了本意。我们围绕这一任务组织该库：审阅者只需将形式化陈述与其自然语言对应版本比较，无需阅读证明。我们的经验是，风险在于陈述而非证明，且对陈述的简单自动化测试甚至能暴露既有文献中的问题。我们以一个教科书定理为例说明这一点，其假设比所声称的更为严格。我们邀请反问题社区扩展并基于该库进行构建。
translation.brief: 介绍由 AI 自动形式化线性正则化理论的 Lean 库 AutoIP，指出形式化风险主要在陈述而非证明。

papers.title: Call-Level Revision Contracts for LLM-Authored Workflows
papers.abstract: Durable execution engines replay a recorded history and do not compare activity payloads. When a model repairs a workflow that failed partway through, it must either pay again for calls that succeeded or accept a recorded result whose payload changed. We define a revision contract for workflows whose orchestration code is written by a model. Each capability call carries a structural identity built from its callsite, its fanout position, and its occurrence count, and the identity stays stable under rewrites that leave the call in place, so committed identities form a frozen prefix. The frozen unit is the call expression, and the surrounding code stays writable. A static gate rejects a rewrite that would change a committed call before a container starts. A runtime digest stops a changed payload at a committed identity, and an occurrence ledger names a repeated paid payload. Under three assumptions, a candidate the gate accepts replays every committed call it invokes, executes only new work, and reports the identities it skips. No local identity is both relocation-invariant and free of wrong reuse, so callsite identity turns a relocation into a pre-spend stop. On media workflows, 22 gate-passed repairs replay 258 committed identities with no duplicate, and a live six-way fanout makes seven paid calls instead of twelve. A 12-task customer-support study applies the same identity, replay, and boundary checks on two models.

translation.title: 面向 LLM 编写工作流的调用级修订契约
translation.abstract: 持久化执行引擎通过重放记录的历史运行，且不比较活动负载。当模型修复一个中途失败的工作流时，它要么为已成功的调用再次付费，要么接受负载已变化的记录结果。我们为编排代码由模型编写的工作流定义了一种修订契约。每个能力调用携带由其调用点、扇出位置和出现次数构建的结构化身份，该身份在保持调用位置不变的改写下保持稳定，因此已提交的身份构成冻结前缀。冻结单元是调用表达式，周围代码保持可写。静态门控在容器启动前拒绝会改变已提交调用的改写。运行时摘要阻止已变更负载通过已提交身份，出现账本标识重复的已付费负载。在三个假设下，门控接受的候选方案会重放其调用的每个已提交调用、只执行新工作，并报告其跳过的身份。不存在既具位置不变性又无错误重用的局部身份，因此调用点身份将位置变更转化为预支出停止。在媒体工作流上，22 次通过门控的修复重放了 258 个已提交身份且无重复，一次实时六路扇出只需 7 次付费调用而非 12 次。一项 12 任务的客服研究在两个模型上应用了相同的身份、重放和边界检查。
translation.brief: 针对模型修复失败工作流时重复付费或误用变更结果的问题，提出基于调用点结构身份的调用级修订契约，实现已提交调用的安全重放。

papers.title: Interactive Backdoor Attacks in LLM-Based Proactive Dialogue Systems
papers.abstract: LLM-based proactive dialogue systems provide goal-directed support through sustained interaction. Fine-tuning their underlying models on externally supplied dialogue data introduces backdoor risks. Existing LLM backdoor studies primarily focus on eliciting an attacker-specified response upon trigger activation. We present an interactive backdoor attack framework that uses training-data poisoning to steer post-trigger, multi-turn interactions toward an attacker-specified objective. Poisoned fine-tuning dialogues implant a trigger-conditioned guidance-policy bias that ordinary user utterances can activate, without deployment-time prompt modification or further attacker intervention. Specifically, we instantiate three complementary attacks under progressively expanded post-trigger interaction settings: (1) Direct Attack, which targets an immediate response deviation upon trigger activation, retaining the conventional trigger--response setting; (2) Constrained Progressive Attack, which progressively advances the attack objective along a predefined multi-turn trajectory; and (3) Unconstrained Progressive Attack, which extends target-directed steering to open-ended interactions with varied user continuations. Using psychological counseling as a representative setting, experiments on two LLM backbones and two dialogue datasets show that all three attacks effectively achieve their objectives under their respective interaction settings while largely preserving normal utility. Separate defense evaluations show that the tested training-data filters retain nearly all poisoned dialogues, while three post-admission baselines leave substantial residual attack-specific success.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 的主动对话系统中的交互式后门攻击
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的主动对话系统通过持续交互提供目标导向的支持。在外部提供的对话数据上微调其底层模型会引入后门风险。现有 LLM 后门研究主要关注触发器激活时引出攻击者指定的响应。我们提出一个交互式后门攻击框架，利用训练数据投毒将触发后的多轮交互引向攻击者指定的目标。被投毒的微调对话植入由普通用户话语即可激活的触发条件引导策略偏置，无需部署时的提示修改或攻击者的进一步干预。具体而言，我们在逐步扩展的触发后交互设置下实例化三种互补攻击：(1) 直接攻击，目标是触发激活时立即产生响应偏差，保留传统的触发-响应设置；(2) 受约束渐进攻击，沿预定义多轮轨迹逐步推进攻击目标；(3) 无约束渐进攻击，将目标导向引导扩展到具有多样用户续写的开放式交互。以心理咨询为代表性场景，在两个 LLM 骨干和两个对话数据集上的实验表明，三种攻击均能在各自交互设置下有效达成目标，同时基本保持正常效用。单独的防御评估表明，所测试的训练数据过滤器几乎保留了所有被投毒对话，而三个准入后基线仍留下大量攻击特有的残余成功率。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 主动对话系统的微调数据投毒风险，提出通过植入触发条件策略偏置来操控触发后多轮交互的交互式后门攻击框架。

papers.title: KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks
papers.abstract: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.

papers.title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
papers.abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDIA A6000, A100, and H100), we evaluate our approach on both tinyBenchmarks and BFCL{; we also include initial tensor-parallel experiments on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Both modes preserve target sequences and Top20-logit bits in the reported tests.} At equal delivered work, {BlockLock-Rows} reduces latency by 53.5--55.0\% and improves throughput by 115.2--122.2\% relative to vLLM Batch-Invariant; compared with batch-invariant kernels, it needs no custom kernel implementations and constrains only the protected requests.

papers.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.

papers.title: The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record
papers.abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine (trace context, A2A/MCP metadata, business-key correlation, probabilistic matching) assigns each record to its business transaction with recorded method and confidence; a versioned rate card prices usage in near real time; period reconciliation ties both ledgers to the invoice, and the unexplained residual identifies shadow AI. Costs are reported per order, claim, or outcome with agentic cost metrics. A simulation with known ground truth shows the spine sustaining cost coverage above 99% as trace propagation falls to zero, the reconciliation residual recovering planted unmetered spend within 0.24 percentage points while flagging provider billing errors, and mid-flight gating cutting p99 transaction cost by up to 61% at a 2-4% false-pause rate. We propose the attribution ledger as an invocation-grain FOCUS profile for standardization.

papers.title: Autonomous AI Agents Systematically Diverge From Human Preferences in Proof Formalization
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems have ushered in a new age of proof abundance, but helping humans understand these proofs requires new attention to the differences in how AI agents and humans pursue a proof-making task. We present "simulated collaboration", a methodology that allows us to examine two key questions: (1) the relative attention AI agents pay to surface syntax or, conversely, deeper underlying semantics, and (2) how and where AI agent preferences for what to do next diverge from human preferences. On a set of nine major human collaborations in Lean with 4.7M definitions across more than 6K commits, we find that, over the course of proof construction, AI agents (1) are far more strongly drawn than humans to explicitly marked gaps; (2) show a relative aversion to densely connected proof centers and to complex or surprising proof goals; and (3) are relatively attracted to surprising proof bodies, which they tend to regularize toward baseline. Our results highlight important blind spots and potential interventions for future human-AI collaboration in mathematics.

papers.title: Trust Responsive Runtime Authorization for Agentic AI with Empirical Characterization of Policy Behavior and Parameter Sensitivity
papers.abstract: The policy that converts runtime estimates of an autonomous agent's condition into operational authority is rarely specified or measured. We empirically characterize the Trust Responsive Authorization Policy (TRAP), which maps an Authorization Readiness Score (ARS), a weighted combination of runtime trust, operational stability, and contextual risk, onto discrete authorization levels through an asymmetric rule: escalation requires consecutive observations above a band edge plus a margin, while a sharp drop in readiness restricts authority at once. On one matched set of 100 Monte Carlo traces, we compare TRAP with static, trust-only, risk-only, and symmetric policies. Under abrupt degradation, TRAP restricts at onset and re-escalates sooner after recovery than the symmetric policy, with the highest and, descriptively, least variable stability among the adaptive policies, although more of its post-recovery escalations occur below the selected trust threshold. Paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero for the remaining differences. In one-factor sweeps, recovery time rises with the escalation margin and run length, shifts with the score weights, and is unchanged by the restriction threshold. In an exploratory post-freeze experiment, when the same degradation is spread over 5-20 intervals, TRAP restricts only on the 4 traces that retain a single-interval drop above that threshold; averaged over all 100 traces, it holds authority above what readiness supports for 15.9-18.9 of the 20 degradation intervals, against 0.8 under abrupt degradation and about 10 for the symmetric policy. Its restriction advantage therefore depends on degradation being abrupt. All reported values are traceable to the publicly available, versioned research release.

translation.title: 面向智能体AI的信任响应式运行时授权：策略行为与参数敏感性的实证刻画
translation.abstract: 将自主智能体运行时状态估计转化为操作权限的策略很少被明确规范或度量。我们对信任响应式授权策略（TRAP）进行了实证刻画，该策略将授权就绪分数（ARS）——运行时信任、操作稳定性和上下文风险的加权组合——通过一条非对称规则映射到离散授权级别：升级需要连续多次观测高于带边界并留有余量，而就绪度的骤降则立即限制权限。在一组匹配的100条Monte Carlo轨迹上，我们将TRAP与静态、仅信任、仅风险和对称策略进行比较。在突然退化情形下，TRAP在退化发生时即进行限制，并在恢复后比对称策略更快重新升级，在自适应策略中具有最高且描述上最稳定的稳定性，尽管其恢复后更多的升级发生在所选信任阈值之下。配对bootstrap区间排除了其余差异为零的可能。在单因素扫描中，恢复时间随升级余量和运行长度增加而上升，随分数权重而偏移，且不受限制阈值影响。在一个探索性的渐进退化实验中，当同样的退化分布在5-20个区间上时，TRAP仅在4条保留单区间骤降超过阈值的轨迹上进行限制；在全部100条轨迹上平均，它在20个退化区间中有15.9-18.9个区间维持的权限高于就绪度所支持的水平，而突然退化情形下为0.8，对称策略约为10。因此其限制优势依赖于退化是突然发生的。所有报告的数值均可追溯至公开可用、带版本管理的研究发布。
translation.brief: 研究如何将智能体运行时信任状态映射为授权级别的问题，采用带非对称升级/降级规则的信任响应式授权策略（TRAP）并进行Monte Carlo实证刻画与参数敏感性分析。

papers.title: An LLM-Orchestrated Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Verifying Diagnostic Signal Reachability in Electronic Systems
papers.abstract: Diagnostic Signal Reachability (DSR) captures whether board-level health signals are observable by management controllers, including baseboard management controllers (BMCs), complex programmable logic devices (CPLDs), and other smart controllers. Verifying DSR is essential for field diagnosability in datacenter fleets, where one design is deployed at massive scale, yet it remains largely manual, since each signal is traced by hand across schematic sheets, renamed nets, series components, and monitoring devices. Large language models (LLMs) are attractive but unreliable at structural connectivity reasoning, where over-claiming can silently hide a rare coverage gap. We present NetFlow-DSR, a neuro-symbolic framework in which an LLM orchestrates the DSR pipeline and resolves device roles mainly from part-name families and library pin names, consulting specifications only for ambiguous parts. Pin directionality is read from the design library, and deterministic graph engines verify connectivity over the authoritative netlist. The pipeline detects diagnostic nets, canonicalizes renamed net fragments, and performs controller-seeded, power-aware breadth-first search over an admissibility graph that credits device-mediated monitoring. Each verdict carries an auditable trace card whose proof path is the witness. Across five production boards from an AI platform, covering 421 expert-graded signals, a three-stage ablation improves pooled F1 from 0.578 to 0.944. Because a monitored verdict is emitted only with a proof path, the verifier is sound by construction, and precision and specificity were 100% in the evaluated data. In a cross-model study on the system-controller module, precision remained 100% across three LLMs while recall tracked each model's device-semantic extraction. Precision therefore depends on the netlist-grounded verifier and correct device semantics rather than on any single LLM.

translation.title: 一种LLM编排的神经符号框架：用于验证电子系统中诊断信号可达性
translation.abstract: 诊断信号可达性（DSR）刻画板级健康信号是否可被管理控制器观测，包括基板管理控制器（BMC）、复杂可编程逻辑器件（CPLD）及其他智能控制器。验证DSR对数据中心机群（同一设计大规模部署）的现场可诊断性至关重要，但目前仍主要依赖人工，因为每个信号都需手工跨原理图页面、重命名网络、串联组件和监控设备进行追踪。大语言模型（LLM）虽有吸引力，但在结构连接性推理上不可靠，过度断言可能悄然掩盖罕见的覆盖缺口。我们提出NetFlow-DSR，一个神经符号框架，其中LLM编排DSR流水线，主要依据器件名称族和库引脚名来判定器件角色，仅对模糊器件查阅规格书。引脚方向性从设计库读取，确定性图引擎在权威网表上验证连接性。该流水线检测诊断网络、规范化重命名的网络片段，并在一个认可器件介导监控的可采纳性图上执行以控制器为种子、考虑供电的广度优先搜索。每个判定都附带可审计的追踪卡，其证明路径即为见证。在来自某AI平台的五块生产板上，覆盖421个专家评分信号，三阶段消融将合并F1从0.578提升至0.944。由于受监控判定仅在存在证明路径时才输出，验证器在构造上是可靠的，且在评估数据中精确率和特异度均为100%。在系统控制器模块的跨模型研究中，三个LLM的精确率均保持100%，而召回率则跟随各模型的器件语义抽取能力。因此精确率依赖于基于网表的验证器和正确的器件语义，而非任何单一LLM。
translation.brief: 解决数据中心板级诊断信号可达性验证依赖人工的问题，采用LLM编排、确定性图引擎在权威网表上验证连接性的神经符号框架NetFlow-DSR。

papers.title: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
papers.abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? We develop a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution following environmental change. Darwinian evolution relies on natural selection, Lamarckian evolution adds inherited learning, and agent-directed evolution allows agents to generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. When learning is sufficiently effective, these mechanisms exhibit progressively faster adaptation. Generating more variants accelerates adaptation, while optimal search effort depends on learning ability, problem difficulty, and experimentation costs. However, an agent's ability to direct its improvement does not ensure that improvements are evaluated against the intended objective. When the evaluation target is misspecified, additional search accelerates convergence toward the wrong behavior, even as measured performance improves. In recursive self-improvement, such errors may persist across generations, posing challenges for AI safety. Independent evaluation and oversight must keep pace with autonomous AI development. The central challenge is not simply to accelerate the evolution of intelligence, but to preserve humanity's ability to guide its direction, limit its speed, and intervene when necessary.

translation.title: 适应之过程的适应：AI中的达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体主导演化
translation.abstract: 演化塑造智能已有数十亿年。人工智能（AI）如今提出了一个引人注目的可能性：智能可能开始主导自身的演化。随着AI智能体变得能够修改和评估自身行为，它们能以多快的速度改进，这种改进又如何保持安全？我们建立了一个理论框架，比较环境变化后的达尔文式、拉马克式和智能体主导演化。达尔文式演化依赖自然选择，拉马克式演化增加了可遗传的学习，而智能体主导演化允许智能体生成和评估行为变体并选择搜索的广度。当学习足够有效时，这些机制表现出逐步加快的适应速度。生成更多变体可加速适应，而最优搜索力度取决于学习能力、问题难度和实验成本。然而，智能体主导自身改进的能力并不能确保改进是针对预期目标进行评估的。当评估目标被错误设定时，额外的搜索会加速向错误行为的收敛，即使测得的性能在提升。在递归自我改进中，此类错误可能跨代延续，给AI安全带来挑战。独立的评估与监督必须跟上自主AI发展的步伐。核心挑战不仅是加速智能的演化，而是保持人类引导其方向、限制其速度并在必要时进行干预的能力。
translation.brief: 研究AI智能体自我改进的速度与安全性问题，建立比较达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体主导演化机制的理论框架并分析目标误设下的风险。

papers.title: Authorization Propagation in Agent2Agent Systems: An Experimental Security Evaluation of Multi-Hop Delegation
papers.abstract: Delegated Agent2Agent (A2A) workflows create a security problem when the agent sending a request is different from the principal from which the authority originated. This paper evaluates a layered downstream-verification design in a synthetic four-party healthcare reimbursement workflow. The prototype separates current-caller context, transitive authorization evidence, per-hop Ed25519 request authentication, and independent replay state for requests and authorization artifacts. Of 15 adversarial conditions, 14 are rejected; an isolated delegation-path test exposes the absence of semantic authority attenuation. A separate authorized-intermediary experiment shows that a holder of the shared authorization-evidence HMAC key can modify the represented authority and generate valid evidence. In the fixed-depth local benchmark, the full configuration has a median security-processing latency of 5.11 ms and a 3.87 kB serialized payload. The results show the value of separating request authentication from inherited authority while identifying origin-verifiable delegation and semantic attenuation as requirements for stronger A2A authorization propagation.

translation.title: Agent2Agent系统中的授权传播：多跳委托的实验性安全评估
translation.abstract: 当发送请求的智能体与权限来源主体不同时，委托式Agent2Agent（A2A）工作流会产生安全问题。本文在一个合成的四方医疗报销工作流中评估了一种分层下游验证设计。原型将当前调用者上下文、传递授权证据、每跳Ed25519请求认证以及针对请求和授权工件的独立重放状态分离开来。在15个对抗条件中，14个被拒绝；一个隔离的委托路径测试暴露了语义权限衰减的缺失。另一项授权中介实验表明，持有共享授权证据HMAC密钥的一方可以修改所代表的权限并生成有效证据。在固定深度的本地基准测试中，完整配置的安全处理延迟中位数为5.11 ms，序列化负载为3.87 kB。结果表明将请求认证与继承权限分离的价值，同时指出可溯源到原始主体的委托和语义衰减是更强A2A授权传播的必要条件。
translation.brief: 研究A2A多跳委托中请求方与权限来源主体不一致带来的安全问题，采用分层下游验证设计（含每跳Ed25519认证与传递授权证据）进行实验性安全评估。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
papers.abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Two loops close the evaluation: an inner loop audits the evidence, rules and metrics themselves, and an outer loop uses per-component regression checks to drive agent improvement. We also give a pipeline that runs this process automatically. Using the business-analysis agent SharpInsight as a case and porting the method to public conversation data, we show how problems differ across levels and how evidence-and-rule judgment is more reliable than holistic scoring (ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81; kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63).

translation.title: 闭环智能体评估：分层度量与自校准
translation.abstract: 智能体上线后，团队想知道它是否在完成本职工作，而不仅仅是是否报错。然而大多数评估是一次性的：跑一次基准、看一遍轨迹、给一个分数。其结论既不自我检验，也反馈不到智能体。我们提出闭环评估，一种面向已部署智能体的评估方法。它将评估建模为在有偏评分者和删失结果下的性能估计，并要求每一层的结论都能追溯到原子数据、由带版本管理的规则计算。该方法覆盖四个分析层级（span、trace、会话与参与度），沿执行、实质、轨迹和结果的主干进行度量，将行为规范（Conduct）作为贯穿始终的约束，并使用溯源（Provenance）与裁定（Adjudication）组件来认证证据和评估者。由Agent Factory生成的评估者智能体携带这些组件，各自配有领域知识包和适配器套件。评估通过两个环路闭合：内环审计证据、规则和指标本身，外环使用逐组件回归检查驱动智能体改进。我们还给出了自动运行该流程的流水线。以商业分析智能体SharpInsight为案例并将该方法移植到公开会话数据上，我们展示了问题如何在不同层级间存在差异，以及证据加规则的判断比整体打分更可靠（ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81；kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63）。
translation.brief: 解决已部署智能体一次性评估无法自我校验和反馈改进的问题，提出覆盖四层级、以证据溯源与规则裁定为核心的闭环评估方法及双环自校准流水线。

papers.title: Reclassification Is All You Missed: Surfacing Variant Reinterpretation Need in Online Health Communities at Population Scale
papers.abstract: Genetic variants are routinely reclassified in ClinVar after a patient is tested, sometimes from uncertain to pathogenic, yet patient recontact is inconsistent, with no clear duty and responsibility diffused among labs, providers, and patients. Many affected people discuss their results in public online health communities that clinical recontact often does not reach. We built PRISM, an agentic large-language-model pipeline that screens these posts, checks whether the variant was later reclassified, and drafts a disclaimer-bearing outreach message, in a no-contact dry run. Across 3.9 million posts from 32 communities, agent-predicted reinterpretation-relevant discussion is rare (0.288%) but concentrated in specialist genetics communities (6.30% versus 0.10% in general medical-advice communities) and growing fivefold since 2014; PRISM surfaces 123 candidate classification differences, 5 of them from an uncertain submission to pathogenic or likely pathogenic. On a held-out set of 30 real-post drafts, a clinician judged 27 factually grounded and 15 fit to send: factual accuracy is necessary but not sufficient for clinically acceptable outreach. PRISM contributes a population-scale reinterpretation-need map with code and data to be released upon publication.

papers.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Generative AI: From Autoregressive Models to Interacting LLM Networks and Neural SDEs
papers.abstract: This paper develops a stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on three classes of generative AI models. First, we formulate large language models (LLMs) as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies. This formulation connects pretraining by conditional maximum likelihood to sequential token generation and provides a probabilistic interpretation of LLM operation. Second, we consider networks of interacting LLMs and characterize their collective behavior through mean-field ordinary differential equations. These dynamics provide a framework for understanding emergent preferential attachment and persistent structural biases, including type-dependent glass-ceiling effects. Third, we consider neural stochastic differential equations (SDEs) as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories, including those observed at irregular time intervals. We discuss their training with particular emphasis on Wiener-space cubature methods based on rough-path analysis as an efficient alternative to Monte Carlo estimation. Together, the three settings address probabilistic prediction, information exchange and emergent behavior in interacting networks, and path-space generative modeling.

papers.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration
papers.abstract: Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid discovery, but naively combining them with team objectives can distort the learning signal, compromising task performance. In this paper, we propose EFXPLORER, a constrained exploration framework that maximizes exploration objectives subject to a constraint that preserves established task performance. We solve the resulting problem using an epigraph reformulation that introduces adaptive exploration budgets. This approach separates intrinsic rewards from task objectives and regulates exploration through task feasibility. To further encourage diverse and temporally extended exploration, we incorporate a successor distance-based intrinsic reward that captures long-horizon dependencies. Empirically, our method outperforms strong baselines and induces novel cooperative strategies across SMAX, VMAS, and MPE benchmark suites.

papers.title: When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization
papers.abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. The strongest tested configuration, GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini, improves agreement to 34.4% but remains below the same-model baseline and is dominated by direct contradiction (42.7%). We also detect a critical verification artifact in which a weaker Implementer satisfies the postcondition by invoking the Specifier's predicate directly; after structural auditing, corrected agreement falls from 14.3% to 13.2%. Our results show that verification success alone is insufficient evidence of independent cross-agent agreement, and that model capability does not guarantee agreement when formalizing the same source independently.

papers.title: DMuon: Scaling Matrix Optimizers in Data Parallelism with Topology-Aware Matrix Ownership and Communication
papers.abstract: Matrix optimizers such as Muon update whole weight matrices, which conflicts with the element- or row-wise sharding of data-parallel runtimes. Once parameters are sharded as well, matrix optimizers incur extra communication or repeated computation. We present DMuon, a matrix-granular optimizer runtime for PyTorch FSDP (ZeRO-2/3) and HSDP. DMuon assigns each matrix a unique owner, which performs the Newton--Schulz (NS) iteration and optimizer update on the full matrix, and balances the load across owners by computational cost. On HSDP, ownership is global across replicas, so the cluster keeps a single copy of gradients and optimizer state, and updated parameters are published across nodes as soon as they are ready, overlapping subsequent computation. This layout makes every collective sparse and variable in length, so DMuon schedules these collectives as their data becomes ready and routes them along the cluster's two-level network. On up to 256 H100 GPUs, across three dense LLMs and two VLA models, DMuon matches or exceeds the training throughput of PyTorch FSDP2 with AdamW, reaching 1.05$\times$ that of FSDP2 with AdamW at the median on 256 GPUs. The optimized parameter gathering and gradient reduction absorb the extra communication and computation a matrix optimizer requires. Against a gather-then-replicate Muon baseline, DMuon's throughput is 2.1 times as high at the median.

papers.title: Polynomial-Time Computation of Extensive-Form Proper Equilibria in Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
papers.abstract: We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for computing an exact extensive-form proper equilibrium in a finite two-player zero-sum extensive-form game with perfect recall and rational data. Properness is understood in the agent normal form: an action at an information set is penalized relative to a better action while all other local behavioral choices, including the player's own future actions, remain fixed. Our algorithm assigns each information set a geometric permutahedron of allowable action probabilities. A scaled doubly stochastic representation embeds these restrictions in a polynomial-size sequence-form polytope; a saddle point then satisfies the local $\varepsilon$-properness inequalities. To obtain an exact equilibrium rather than a solution at an arbitrarily small numerical perturbation, we establish sign stability of a parametric linear system, construct a persistent feasible basis, and extract the limits of behavioral ratios. The resulting probabilities are rational and have polynomial encoding length, including at information sets whose realization probabilities vanish.

papers.title: Server-Side Sparse Assignment for Federated Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly recognized for their remarkable capabilities; federated learning (FL) offers a promising framework for collaboratively fine-tuning LLMs on edge devices while achieving data privacy. However, edge devices are inherently heterogeneous: clients may exhibit diverse data distributions and resource constraints, including limited memory and computation budgets. Recent federated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address these challenges by using sparse expert activation or partial expert loading. However, existing partial-expert methods rely on heuristic full-pool observations or prioritize system-wide load balance, without guarantees for recovering client-specific relevant experts from partial observations. We propose $S^3$-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments through an exploit--explore mechanism. We also establish relevance-estimation error and exact Top-$K$ recovery guarantees. Experiments using a CNN-based MoE on CIFAR-100 show that $S^3$-MoE recovers task-dependent client--expert preferences and reduces conflicts caused by correlated expert selection across clients. Compared with Full-20 FedAvg, which gives each client access to all 20 experts for local Top-5 routing, $S^3$-MoE achieves 1.31 percentage points higher mean final accuracy while loading only $5$ experts per client.

papers.title: A Night at the LLM Zoo: Data Conditioned Flow Matching for Generating Pretrained LLM Weights
papers.abstract: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. By demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held out mixtures, measuring Continuous Ranked Probability Score skill, as well as finding minimal changes in downstream test-set perplexity and general capability benchmark scores, we show that our generator generalizes on the simplex of data mixtures to produce models that perform similarly to those in the zoo ex nihilo. Finally, we produce all source code and artifacts to support the continued expansion of Weight Space Learning and Generation into the LLM domain.

translation.abstract: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. By demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held out mixtures, measuring Continuous Ranked Probability Score skill, as well as finding minimal changes in downstream test-set perplexity and general capability benchmark scores, we show that our generator generalizes on the simplex of data mixtures to produce models that perform similarly to those in the zoo ex nihilo. Finally, we produce all source code and artifacts to support the continued expansion of Weight Space Learning and Generation into the LLM domain.

papers.title: NUMA-Torch: Compiler-Driven NUMA-Aware LLM Prefill on Multi-Socket CPUs
papers.abstract: For sufficiently large transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs), whose parameters cannot be retained in on-chip caches, prefill throughput on multi-socket CPUs is often limited by sustainable DRAM bandwidth rather than peak floating-point throughput. In the standard PyTorch compilation (i.e., TorchInductor) path, model weights are allocated without considering the Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) topology: specifically, the affinity between memory banks and compute cores is disregarded. This causes a substantial fraction of weight accesses to traverse the inter-socket interconnect, severely degrading the effective memory bandwidth available to each socket. We address this bottleneck through a compiler-level solution that makes TorchInductor NUMA-aware. Treating each NUMA socket as an independent tensor-parallel partition, we introduce NUMA-aware Tensor Parallelism (NUMA-TP). This approach transparently shards weights across sockets and schedules compute kernels such that thread pools and memory allocations remain strictly local to their respective sockets using CPU affinity. We evaluate the approach on GPT-2 (117M, 345M, 762M) and BERT (Small, Large), which exercise standard multi-head attention and MLP, as well as Gemma 3 270M, which combines Multi-Query Attention with a GeGLU-gated MLP. By strictly enforcing data locality, our approach successfully mitigates cross-socket traffic, achieving prefill speedups of up to 2.63x on a dual-socket Haswell platform, up to 1.87x on a dual-socket Cascade Lake platform, and up to 2.27x on a four-socket Haswell-EX platform.

papers.title: Regulating Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand Operators with Fixed and Adaptive Penalties: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract: Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly controls pricing and rebalancing, and dynamic regulation as a Partially Observable Stochastic Game in which a regulator periodically adjusts region-specific penalties in closed loop. Operator and regulator policies are learned with graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning. In experiments with real-world Manhattan data, fixed surge pricing penalties reduce the share of travelers facing excessive prices from 22% to 1%. For regional service availability, dynamic regulation improves the regulator's reward by up to 15.6% over fixed penalties of equal mean intensity. The gains in service availability are strongest when spare fleet capacity exists, whereas service deficits persist in peak periods with highly utilized fleets. The learned regulator policy responds by reducing penalties where limited fleet capacity restricts compliance. The results identify trade-offs between regulatory targets, operator profitability, and traveler utility.

papers.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. We instantiate the framework with five prompt optimization methods: GEPA, SIMBA, Rubric Synthesis, and exemplar selection using either simulated annealing or a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator. Our experiments demonstrate that iterative prompt optimization can recalibrate LLM judges and recover performance after controlled shifts in the referencescore distribution. However, effective maintenance is inherently contextdependent: neither optimization algorithm choice nor update timing generalizes universally across settings. These findings establish prompt optimization for deployed LLM judges as an inherently iterative maintenance problem and demonstrate that PromptOps provides a practical abstraction for studying and implementing this process.

papers.title: Adapting LLM Judges to Observed Human Annotation Policy through Soft Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed as automated judges for evaluating chatbot responses. While proprietary models can achieve high agreement with human annotators, they remain costly and difficult to deploy in practical settings. Lightweight open-source LLM judges provide an attractive alternative but typically exhibit lower agreement with human ratings. In this paper, we investigate whether soft prompt tuning can align open-source LLM judges more closely with human annotation policy. We train soft prompts on the FairBotBench benchmark and evaluate the adapted judges across the dimensions of bias, toxicity, and personalization. Our findings demonstrate that hybrid soft-prompt tuning, which combines textual prompts with learned continuous prompt embeddings, consistently improves agreement with human annotations over the corresponding untuned baselines. For Qwen 3.5 9B, the adapted judges surpass both hosted reference judges across all three evaluation dimensions.

papers.title: Teaching Agents the "Principle", Not the "Reward"
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved strong performance in many tasks by letting agents learn from nothing more than a reward signal. However, in more complex tasks, agents still struggle to learn good, generalizable policies, even with carefully designed rewards and abundant samples. We argue that this difficulty stems from the reward decoding burden: designers encode their knowledge of the desired behavior into rewards and penalties, and agents must infer this knowledge from long sequences of noisy scalars. To address this burden, we propose prescriptive policy learning (PPL), which directly teaches agents higher-level knowledge about the tasks, termed principles of behavior, such as how to maintain balance, how to accumulate energy, and how to land smoothly. Through appropriately selected key quantities and references, PPL can directly indicate at every step whether the agent follows the principles and to what extent. Our experiments show that agents can learn good, generalizable policies without any reward. Taught only simple heuristic principles, PPL agents outperform reward-based methods with far fewer samples. Their policies also transfer directly to harder settings and keep performing well, demonstrating their strong generalization ability. In summary, PPL provides a new approach in which rough knowledge of the desired behavior is enough for agents to learn good, generalizable policies, even when the system dynamics cannot be accurately modeled.

papers.title: More Agents, More Reliable? System-Level Reliability of Multi-Agent LLMs under Operational-Profile Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Teams increasingly build software from cooperating large language model (LLM) agents, often assuming more agents mean more reliability. Yet the usual evidence, average benchmark accuracy, ignores the input mix a deployed system meets and the rule merging the agents' answers. Building on HIP-LLM, a hierarchical imprecise-probability assessment of single LLMs, we propose a framework combining it with a Bayesian network of the system's failure logic for multi-agent systems. Agent failure-probability intervals propagate through this network, where the combining rule can itself fail, into a reliability envelope showing which evidence limits it. In a pipeline extracting regulated chemical-hazard statements, majority voting over three models protected against the weakest but did not clearly exceed the best, and a voter failing on 5\% of demands would largely erase its advantage over the middle model. More agents yield a more defensible reliability claim, not automatically a more reliable system.

papers.title: Depth or Description? When a One-Step Latent Score Replaces Lookahead in Proactive Information Acquisition
papers.abstract: A proactive agent must decide what to ask before it acts. Exact lookahead values combinations of questions but is expensive and leans on a fitted model; a one-step score is cheap but can miss them. Our main finding: the need for depth often lies in how the hidden cause is described. A one-step score on the label can be blind to an interaction among answers. A score on a suitable latent cause is not, and where that latent encodes the decision it replaces most of depth at a fraction of the search. Described differently, the same problem can defeat the score while exact values do not move, so keep the latent small and check it against exact values. Probabilities learned from one language model's answers do not carry to another unless planning allows for both; those read from tokens are worth only a few labels.

papers.title: Multi-step SWE: Can Coding Agents Keep Building on Their Own Code Over Long Horizons?
papers.abstract: Developers rarely give a coding agent a single request: they ask it to build a component and then to extend, upgrade, and optimize it, each time on code the agent itself wrote. Most benchmarks, however, score one task at a time. We introduce Multi-step SWE, a long-horizon benchmark of 69 software engineering tasks, each a chain of 5-15 dependent steps on a single codebase. Every step is a complete, multi-hour engineering request that starts from the code the agent produced in the preceding steps, so early design decisions and errors carry forward. The tasks span four families of engineering work and nine languages, include both from-scratch builds and existing open-source codebases, and ground every step in an existing source of truth that defines both the instruction and its verifier. Across nine frontier models, the strongest model reaches a solve rate of only 18.5%, and 38 of the 69 tasks are not solved by any model. We release Multi-step SWE publicly at this https URL.

translation.title: Multi-step SWE：编码智能体能否在长时程中持续构建于自身代码之上？
translation.abstract: 开发者很少只给编码智能体一个请求：他们通常要求其构建一个组件，然后进行扩展、升级和优化，每次都基于智能体自己写的代码。然而大多数基准测试一次只评估一个任务。我们提出 Multi-step SWE，一个包含 69 个软件工程任务的长时程基准，每个任务是在单一代码库上由 5-15 个相互依赖的步骤组成的链条。每一步都是一个完整的、需要数小时的工程请求，从智能体在前序步骤产出的代码开始，因此早期设计决策和错误会持续传递。任务涵盖四类工程工作和九种编程语言，既包括从零构建，也包括现有开源代码库，且每一步都锚定于一个既定义指令又定义验证器的既有事实来源。在九个前沿模型中，最强模型的解决率仅为 18.5%，69 个任务中有 38 个没有任何模型能解决。我们在此 https URL 公开发布 Multi-step SWE。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法评估智能体在自身代码上持续迭代的问题，提出由 5-15 个依赖步骤组成的长时程软件工程基准 Multi-step SWE。

papers.title: Meta-Frieren: Beyond Single Level Online Learning
papers.abstract: We study a two-stage online optimization problem: at each round, a meta-learner first selects an agent-environment pair, then the chosen agent interacts with the environment, and receives a reward. We introduce Meta-Frieren, a general framework for maximizing cumulative reward in this setting. Our analysis yields a simple UCB-style criterion for meta-level selection and recovers prior guarantees as special cases while extending them to broader settings. We instantiate Meta-Frieren with GP-UCB under Bayesian and frequentist assumptions. We also derive, to our knowledge, the first high-probability regret bound for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling, specialize it to finite and parametric function classes, and integrate it into Meta-Frieren. Experiments support our theoretical results and demonstrate that Meta-Frieren can be successfully applied to hyperparameter optimization across multiple model classes.

translation.title: Meta-Frieren：超越单层在线学习
translation.abstract: 我们研究一个两阶段在线优化问题：每一轮中，元学习器先选择一个智能体-环境对，然后被选中的智能体与环境交互并获得奖励。我们提出 Meta-Frieren，一个用于在此设定下最大化累积奖励的通用框架。我们的分析给出了一个简单的 UCB 风格的元层选择准则，并将先前保证作为特例加以恢复，同时将其扩展到更广泛的设定。我们在贝叶斯和频率派假设下用 GP-UCB 实例化 Meta-Frieren。我们还推导了据我们所知首个 Feel-Good Thompson Sampling 的高概率遗憾界，将其特化到有限函数类和参数化函数类，并集成到 Meta-Frieren 中。实验支持了我们的理论结果，并表明 Meta-Frieren 可成功应用于跨多个模型类的超参数优化。
translation.brief: 针对元层选择智能体-环境对的在线优化问题，提出基于 UCB 风格选择准则的通用框架 Meta-Frieren。

papers.title: MammoSeek: A Mammography Agent with selective zooming for grounded reports
papers.abstract: Radiologists read a screening mammogram by first forming a global impression of the four views and then selectively magnifying suspicious regions before assigning a BI-RADS assessment. MLLMs, in contrast, see the whole image at a fixed, reduced resolution, which makes sub-millimeter calcifications invisible, and they perform close to chance on mammography. Therefore, we present MammoSeek, a mammography agent that reproduces this reading process. After forming an impression of each breast, the agent performs selective zooming: it decides by itself which detector candidates deserve a closer look and inspects only those on full-resolution views. Guided by a BI-RADS assessment skill, it then assigns a category and generates a localized, lexicon-structured report for each breast; its assessment is combined with image-model scores in a decision layer to decide recall. On an internal (EMBED) and an external (VinDr-Mammo) dataset, \ours reaches exam-level AUCs of 0.824 and 0.818, far above other MLLMs, mammography agent and CNN classifiers. Selective zooming also outperforms both no zooming and forced zooming in localization, structured-report F1 and recall decisions at low cost.

translation.title: MammoSeek：具有选择性放大功能的乳腺钼靶智能体，用于有依据的报告生成
translation.abstract: 放射科医生阅读筛查性乳腺钼靶片时，先对四个视图形成整体印象，然后选择性地放大可疑区域，再给出 BI-RADS 评估。相比之下，MLLM 以固定的、降低的分辨率查看整幅图像，使亚毫米级钙化不可见，其在乳腺钼靶任务上的表现接近随机。因此，我们提出 MammoSeek，一个复现这一阅片过程的乳腺钼靶智能体。在对每侧乳房形成印象后，智能体执行选择性放大：它自行决定哪些检测候选区域值得细看，并仅在全分辨率视图上检查这些区域。在 BI-RADS 评估技能的引导下，它为每侧乳房分配类别并生成带定位信息的、基于词典结构的报告；其评估与图像模型分数在决策层结合以决定是否召回。在内部（EMBED）和外部（VinDr-Mammo）数据集上，MammoSeek 分别达到 0.824 和 0.818 的检查级 AUC，远高于其他 MLLM、乳腺钼靶智能体和 CNN 分类器。选择性放大在定位、结构化报告 F1 和低成本的召回决策上也优于不放大和强制放大。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 因固定低分辨率无法看清乳腺钼靶细微病灶的问题，提出模拟放射科医生阅片流程、通过选择性放大可疑区域生成定位报告的智能体 MammoSeek。

papers.title: SeVerus: Context-Aware, Gamified Benchmarking for Rust Verification
papers.abstract: Coding agents achieve high success rates on existing benchmarks for Verus, a verifier for Rust programs. These benchmarks typically provide the auxiliary lemmas needed to complete a proof. In practice, however, such lemmas must be discovered and proved. To capture this challenge, we present SEVERUS, a context-aware technique to generate Verus benchmarks that organizes verification tasks into quests, each divided into levelsin a gamified manner. Using the original proof dependencies in verified projects, SEVERUS constructs one quest per verification target and progressively removes proof context to create individual levels. These levels range from the easiest, requiring completing only a single missing lemma, to the hardest, requiring proving the target without any supporting lemmas. An independent checker rejects changes to executable code, weakened specifications, and unsound proof constructs. A noisy binary search estimates the highest level that an agent can solve reliably. Applied to six open-source Verus projects, SEVERUS generates 819 quests comprising 10,095 levels. Experiments with Codex using GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, and with Claude Code using Sonnet 4.6, show that success decreases and cost increases as proof context is withdrawn. The strongest agent solves the final level of 52 of 60 sampled quests, yet can only reliably solve 35% of their levels, with failures concentrated in longer quests. Successful GPT-6 Sol proofs rarely reproduce the withheld lemmas, instead, using alternative proof decompositions. By systematically varying proof context, SEVERUS provides a foundation for constructing verification benchmarks that can continue to challenge increasingly capable coding agents.

translation.title: SeVerus：面向 Rust 验证的上下文感知、游戏化基准构建
translation.abstract: 编码智能体在 Verus（一个 Rust 程序验证器）的现有基准上取得了很高的成功率。这些基准通常提供完成证明所需的辅助引理。但在实践中，这些引理必须被发现并证明。为捕捉这一挑战，我们提出 SEVERUS，一种上下文感知的 Verus 基准生成技术，它以游戏化方式将验证任务组织为任务链（quest），每条任务链划分为多个关卡。利用已验证项目中的原始证明依赖，SEVERUS 为每个验证目标构建一条任务链，并通过逐步移除证明上下文来创建各个关卡。这些关卡从最简单的（只需补全单个缺失引理）到最难的（需在没有任何辅助引理的情况下证明目标）。一个独立的检查器会拒绝对可执行代码的修改、被弱化的规范以及不健全的证明构造。噪声二分搜索用于估计智能体能可靠解决的最高关卡。应用于六个开源 Verus 项目，SEVERUS 生成了 819 条任务链，共 10,095 个关卡。使用 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 的 Codex 以及使用 Sonnet 4.6 的 Claude Code 的实验表明，随着证明上下文被移除，成功率下降而成本上升。最强的智能体解决了 60 条抽样任务链中 52 条的最终关卡，但只能可靠解决其中 35% 的关卡，失败集中在较长的任务链上。成功的 GPT-6 Sol 证明很少复现被扣留的引理，而是采用替代的证明分解。通过系统地变化证明上下文，SEVERUS 为构建能持续挑战日益强大的编码智能体的验证基准奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 针对现有 Verus 基准提供现成辅助引理而低估验证难度的问题，提出通过逐步移除证明上下文生成游戏化分级基准的技术 SeVerus。

papers.title: Capability Gain from ISA to Shared Execution on AMD MI300A and MI250X
papers.abstract: Each new GPU generation is showcased by its peak instruction rates, yet users hardly ever run instructions directly: they reach the hardware's performance through vendor libraries, applications and devices shared with other jobs. How much of a theoretical speedup survives these layers is rarely measured, so a team deciding whether to move to a new generation, or to adopt FP8 or 2:4 sparsity, lacks adequate guidance. AMD's MI300A (CDNA3) adds new FP8 matrix instructions and 2:4 structured-sparse instructions that the predecessor, the MI250X (CDNA2), does not have. We analyze this theoretical speedup gap on AMD's MI300A (CDNA3) against the MI250X (CDNA2) by defining a new metric, capability gain. Capability gain is the fraction of a feature's instruction-level speedup that it keeps at a higher level, such as a library, an application or a shared device. We trace it from ISA microbenchmarks through hipBLASLt and hipSPARSELt to LLM inference and mixed-precision HPL, and onto a device shared by up to eight concurrent streams. FP8 keeps most of its speedup through the library, completing an $8192^3$ GEMM \genCapPkgEndToEndGainEightK{} faster than the MI250X with FP16, but unfused quantization turns it into a per-layer slowdown in an LLM, and 2:4 sparsity keeps at most about half of its speedup in hipSPARSELt. Under queue sharing, FP8's GEMM capability gain rises above 1. How fairly streams share the device depends on the number of hardware queues, not on the numeric precision, yet shared LLM serving gains nothing from FP8.

translation.brief: 针对理论指令级加速比在库、应用和共享设备等更高层级能保留多少缺乏测量的问题，提出能力增益指标并追踪 FP8 与 2:4 稀疏性在 AMD MI300A 各软件层的保留情况。

papers.title: IRIS: Intelligent Random Access with Integrated Shared Learning for Decentralized LEO Direct-to-Satellite Uplinks
papers.abstract: Grant-free uplink access in low-Earth-orbit (LEO) non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) poses a coordination challenge when multiple UEs share a satellite channel without real-time centralized scheduling under long propagation delays and time-varying channels. Conventional random access does not exploit peer context, leading to collisions and inefficient channel use as contention increases. To address this problem, we propose IRIS, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for decentralized grant-free direct-to-satellite (D2S) uplink access, with A2A-IRIS as its sidelink-assisted Agent-to-Agent (A2A) realization. Each UE executes a shared binary transmission policy using local traffic/channel information augmented by compact peer states exchanged over UE-to-UE sidelink, while Vanilla-IRIS serves as a local-only ablation. Evaluations in rural and suburban LEO D2S deployments use TLE-based trajectories propagated using the Simplified General Perturbations 4 (SGP4), with a Walker-Delta constellation as fallback. A2A-IRIS achieves 2.1579 and 5.4478 Mbps, corresponding to 99.9% and 96.1% of the respective scenario-specific upper bounds. Relative to Vanilla-IRIS, throughput improves by 40.8% and 325.0%, with collision rates of 0.0000 and 0.0433, while one- and two-epoch delayed centralized schedulers are outperformed by approximately 51--130%. A2A-IRIS also improves fairness, service coverage, and transmission efficiency with moderate Deep Q-Network (DQN) inference overhead. Active-UE load scalability results further show sustained performance over the evaluated load range. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of sidelink-assisted A2A coordination for decentralized LEO D2S uplink access under propagation delay and delayed channel feedback.

papers.title: τ-bench-LILT: Evaluating Conversational Agents on Realistic Multilingual Tool-Use Tasks
papers.abstract: Frontier evaluations of tool-using conversational agents are conducted almost exclusively in English, leaving a critical gap for organizations deploying agents in other languages and regions. We present ${\tau}$-bench-LILT, a multilingual extension of ${\tau^3}$-bench covering German, Korean, Turkish, and Farsi in the airline, retail, telecom, and banking domains. We natively localize every layer of the benchmark: customer databases are populated with culturally appropriate records, user-simulator prompts are refined iteratively through contrastive annotation by native-language experts, and tasks are updated according to the localized database and to reflect realistic tasks in the target region. Evaluation across eight agent models shows the largest drops compared to English in the Korean and Farsi retail domains, by up to 61 points in pass^4. Code and data released at this https URL.

papers.title: Structured Machine Theory of Mind from Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract: Predictive models of human behavior trained on large-scale trajectory data optimize for statistical accuracy without representing the mental states that causally generate behavior. Such models support prediction but not principled intervention: they cannot answer how an agent's behavior would change if its beliefs or preferences were different. We introduce Structured Machine Theory of Mind (SMToM), a framework that attributes explicit, independently supervised belief and desire representations from observed trajectories within a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) causal structure. The central architectural element is a goal head that consumes only the predicted mental-state channels and a current-trajectory embedding; counterfactual intervention on beliefs and desires is a direct operation. We instantiate SMToM on a controlled pedestrian navigation domain where ground-truth mental states are known by construction, enabling evaluation of attribution accuracy, local channel interventions, and trajectory-level counterfactual diagnostics. The resulting model, BDIBottleneck, improves over trajectory-only and unsupervised-context neural baselines. It is also competitive with a matched auxiliary-supervised context baseline while providing an editable mental-state interface that the unbottlenecked baseline lacks. Counterfactual experiments on desires confirm that substituting an agent's inferred preferences with a different activity type coherently shifts predicted destinations toward relevant locations. Counterfactual experiments on beliefs confirm that marking a location as unavailable in the agent's belief state reduces its predicted probability as a destination, though in a complex way. These results demonstrate, in a controlled navigation setting, that explicit BDI-structured supervision is a viable foundation for interpretable and counterfactual analysis of longitudinal trajectory data.
