papers.title: Deep reinforcement learning-based optimization of multi-RAT handovers
papers.abstract: A major evolutionary goal and challenge for next-generation wireless systems is seamless multiple radio access technology (multi-RAT) mobility. In a multi-RAT environment, handover decisions must account for both user quality of service and network priorities, including signal quality, resource availability, energy consumption, latency, and security. Although WiFi/cellular mobility is well explored in research and standardization, many conventional handover mechanisms continue to rely primarily on received signal strength. Such decisions may overlook link delay, congestion, and the distinct operating characteristics of heterogeneous RATs. In this work, we present the Reinforced Flexible Multi-RAT Selection framework (ReFlexMRS), a configurable Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based approach for multi-criteria handover target selection. ReFlexMRS is evaluated using an SDN-enabled multi-RAT testbed. The decision problem is formulated as a Markov Decision Process with a finite action space and is addressed using a Deep Q-Network (DQN) with convolutional layers that extract relationships among network measurement features. The agent is trained offline from collected network observations using reward guided Q-value updates, then used to select handover targets during inference. A 5G-WiFi case study demonstrates that ReFlexMRS can trade a small amount of throughput for substantial improvements in link delay, handover stability, and WiFi offloading. Compared with RSSI-based selection, the proposed formulations retain approximately 90-95% of the baseline throughput while reducing total handovers by up to 18% and WiFi-to-5G handovers by up to 13%, while maintaining the required RSSI levels.

translation.title: 基于深度强化学习的多RAT切换优化
translation.abstract: 下一代无线系统的一个主要演进目标与挑战是实现无缝的多无线接入技术（multi-RAT）移动性。在多RAT环境中，切换决策必须同时考虑用户服务质量与网络优先级，包括信号质量、资源可用性、能耗、时延和安全性。尽管WiFi/蜂窝移动性在研究和标准化中已被充分探索，但许多传统切换机制仍主要依赖接收信号强度。这类决策可能忽视链路时延、拥塞以及异构RAT各自不同的运行特性。在本工作中，我们提出了Reinforced Flexible Multi-RAT Selection框架（ReFlexMRS），这是一种可配置的、基于深度强化学习（DRL）的多准则切换目标选择方法。ReFlexMRS在一个支持SDN的多RAT测试床上进行评估。该决策问题被建模为具有有限动作空间的马尔可夫决策过程，并使用带卷积层的Deep Q-Network（DQN）求解，卷积层用于提取网络测量特征之间的关系。智能体利用收集到的网络观测数据通过奖励引导的Q值更新进行离线训练，然后在推理阶段用于选择切换目标。一个5G-WiFi案例研究表明，ReFlexMRS可以用少量吞吐量换取链路时延、切换稳定性和WiFi卸载方面的大幅改善。与基于RSSI的选择相比，所提出的方案在保持所需RSSI水平的同时，保留了约90-95%的基线吞吐量，并将总切换次数最多减少18%，WiFi到5G的切换次数最多减少13%。
translation.brief: 针对多RAT环境下仅依赖信号强度的切换决策问题，提出基于DQN的多准则切换目标选择框架ReFlexMRS。

papers.title: CacheGraft: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Latent-Space Document Enrichment
papers.abstract: Recent work in machine learning has demonstrated that transformer-based language model agents can communicate state not only through text, but also directly in latent space via key-value (KV) caches. In this paper, we argue that such cache-to-cache translation can provide utility beyond the original motivating application of real-time agent communication and can instead be utilized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Building on the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework, our proposed system CacheGraft encodes each corpus passage offline into a fused KV cache representation between a larger sharer model (4B parameters in our experiments) and a smaller receiver model (0.6B parameters) such that this cache can be injected into the receiver at query time with no need for the larger model. Across five QA benchmarks and two independent locally-run judges, CacheGraft improves answer quality over the text-only receiver baseline in 29 out of 30 comparisons, of which 17 of the 30 are statistically significant. Notably, these gains are zero-shot with respect to the fuser, which was never trained on retrieval data. These initial results suggest that latent-space document enrichment may be a promising avenue for enhancing the performance of RAG systems, particularly in compute-constrained settings where it is only feasible to deploy a small model at inference time.

translation.title: CacheGraft：通过潜空间文档增强提升检索增强生成
translation.abstract: 近期的机器学习研究表明，基于transformer的语言模型智能体不仅可以通文本，还可以通过键值（KV）缓存在潜空间中直接传递状态。本文认为，这种缓存到缓存的转换可以超越其实时智能体通信这一最初应用场景，转而用于检索增强生成（RAG）。在Cache-to-Cache（C2C）融合框架的基础上，我们提出的系统CacheGraft将语料库中的每个段落离线编码为一个大共享模型（实验中为4B参数）与一个小接收模型（0.6B参数）之间的融合KV缓存表示，使得该缓存可以在查询时注入接收模型，而无需使用大模型。在五个问答基准和两个独立运行的本地评判器上，CacheGraft在30组对比中的29组中优于纯文本接收模型基线，其中17组具有统计显著性。值得注意的是，这些增益对融合器而言是零样本的，因为融合器从未在检索数据上训练过。这些初步结果表明，潜空间文档增强可能是提升RAG系统性能的一条有前景的途径，尤其是在推理时只能部署小模型的算力受限场景中。
translation.brief: 针对RAG中只能部署小模型的算力受限问题，提出CacheGraft，通过离线将文档编码为KV缓存注入小模型来增强检索。

papers.title: Vis2State: Visual Reasoning through Executable State Abstractions
papers.abstract: Solving visual puzzles requires both accurate interpretation of visual evidence and reliable computation under task-specific rules. Embedding visual assumptions and task constraints directly in solving code makes the represented problem difficult to inspect and revise independently. We introduce Vis2State, a training-free agentic framework that abstracts visual puzzles into explicit, revisable problem states linking visual inspection and execution. Visual inspection guides state construction and refinement, while generated programs solve the represented problem. The model constructs both the state and the program without predefined puzzle schemas or solving procedures. Inspection and execution feedback allow it to revise the problem representation and solving procedure independently. Vis2State achieves the state-of-the-art performance on four benchmarks. Cross-model evaluation further demonstrates consistent gains. Ablations, error analyses, and fixed-program state interventions further support the effectiveness of the state-centered design. The code will be made publicly available to facilitate future research.

translation.title: Vis2State：通过可执行状态抽象进行视觉推理
translation.abstract: 解决视觉谜题既需要对视觉证据的准确解读，也需要在任务特定规则下进行可靠计算。将视觉假设和任务约束直接嵌入求解代码中，会使所表示的问题难以独立检查和修改。我们提出Vis2State，这是一个无需训练的智能体框架，它将视觉谜题抽象为显式、可修改的问题状态，从而连接视觉检查与执行。视觉检查引导状态的构建与细化，而生成的程序则求解所表示的问题。模型在没有预定义谜题模式或求解过程的情况下，同时构建状态和程序。检查与执行反馈使其能够独立地修改问题表示和求解过程。Vis2State在四个基准上取得了最先进的性能。跨模型评估进一步证明了一致的增益。消融实验、错误分析以及固定程序的状态干预进一步支持了以状态为中心的设计的有效性。代码将公开发布以促进未来研究。
translation.brief: 针对视觉谜题求解中视觉假设与求解代码耦合难以修改的问题，提出无需训练的Vis2State框架，将谜题抽象为显式可修改的状态并由生成程序求解。

papers.title: PSGAgent: Enhancing MLLMs' Dynamic Visual Perception for Panoptic Scene Graph Generation via Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Panoptic Scene Graph generation (PSG) requires holistic yet fine-grained reasoning over complex relations among objects. However, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) applied to PSG suffer from a perception bottleneck: they function as static observers limited by fixed-resolution views. As a result, models often overlook critical relations involving small or peripheral objects and struggle to differentiate ambiguous predicates in complex scenes. To address these limitations, we propose PSGAgent, an agentic framework that enhances visual perception for PSG through a think-act-observe loop. PSGAgent allows MLLMs to dynamically refine their visual perception using two tools: a Region Zoom-In Tool for local exploration of small or boundary relations and a Visual Highlight Tool for relation-focused segmentation that filters out irrelevant contextual noise. To optimize decision-making, we construct a two-stage training pipeline. First, we create a high-quality, error-aware Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (M-CoT) dataset that provides robust supervision for cold-start learning. Then, we design a novel hierarchical reward mechanism integrated with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) to enable strategic and adaptive tool usage. Extensive experiments on the PSG benchmark show that PSGAgent achieves SOTA performance, demonstrating strong capability in both holistic and fine-grained scene understanding.

translation.title: PSGAgent：通过智能体推理增强MLLM在全景场景图生成中的动态视觉感知
translation.abstract: 全景场景图生成（PSG）需要对对象间复杂关系进行整体而细粒度的推理。然而，当前应用于PSG的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）存在感知瓶颈：它们作为静态观察者，受限于固定分辨率的视图。因此，模型常常忽视涉及小对象或边缘对象的关键关系，并难以在复杂场景中区分模糊的谓词。为解决这些局限，我们提出PSGAgent，这是一个通过“思考-行动-观察”循环增强PSG视觉感知的智能体框架。PSGAgent使MLLM能够使用两种工具动态细化其视觉感知：用于局部探索小对象或边界关系的区域放大工具，以及用于以关系为中心的分割、过滤无关上下文噪声的视觉高亮工具。为优化决策，我们构建了一个两阶段训练流程。首先，我们创建了一个高质量、具备错误感知的多模态思维链（M-CoT）数据集，为冷启动学习提供可靠监督。然后，我们设计了一种与Group Sequence Policy Optimization（GSPO）相结合的新型分层奖励机制，以实现策略性和自适应的工具使用。在PSG基准上的大量实验表明，PSGAgent取得了SOTA性能，在整体和细粒度场景理解方面均展现出强大能力。
translation.brief: 针对MLLM在PSG任务中固定分辨率视图导致的感知瓶颈，提出PSGAgent智能体框架，通过区域放大与视觉高亮工具及分层奖励强化学习实现动态视觉感知。

papers.title: Req2Rust: A Requirements-Guided Agent Harness for Project-Level C++-to-Rust Migration
papers.abstract: Memory-safety concerns make Rust an attractive target for modernizing legacy C/C++ systems, yet project-level C++ migration must balance semantic fidelity with Rust-oriented reconstruction. Source-structure-preserving migration can track low-level behavior, but it can also carry source-language organization, unsafe idioms, and project assumptions into Rust. Direct agent-based translation gives the model more freedom to construct a Rust project, but semantic coverage depends on the model identifying the source behaviors that must be preserved. This problem is especially acute for C++, where source behaviors are often hidden in object models, destructor-driven lifetime protocols, and other hard-to-localize C++ semantics. This paper presents Req2Rust, the first project-level LLM-based C++-to-Rust migration harness. Req2Rust first derives an evidence-grounded Migration Requirements Specification (MRS) that records the behaviors and constraints that must be preserved. It then synthesizes a Rust Design Specification (RDS) and realizes it as an initial Rust project. Because real projects contain implementation details and idioms that only become visible during build and validation, Req2Rust treats the initial Rust project as an executable refinement state. Compiler, semantic, and unsafe-reduction validators produce validation reports for improving buildability, behavioral alignment, and unsafe usage. We evaluate Req2Rust on general C++ projects and modules from the large-scale Openharmony codebase against a ClaudeCode baseline. Req2Rust produces buildable Rust crates in both settings and improves test pass rate from 69.5% to 91.9% on general projects and from 45.4% to 87.9% on Openharmony modules.

translation.title: Req2Rust：面向项目级C++到Rust迁移的需求引导智能体框架
translation.abstract: 内存安全问题使Rust成为现代化改造遗留C/C++系统的理想目标，然而项目级的C++迁移必须在语义保真与面向Rust的重构之间取得平衡。保留源码结构的迁移可以追踪底层行为，但也会将源语言的组织方式、unsafe惯用法和项目假设带入Rust。直接基于智能体的翻译给予模型更大的自由度来构建Rust项目，但语义覆盖取决于模型能否识别出必须保留的源行为。这一问题在C++中尤为突出，因为源行为往往隐藏在对象模型、析构函数驱动的生命周期协议以及其他难以定位的C++语义中。本文提出Req2Rust，这是首个项目级的基于LLM的C++到Rust迁移框架。Req2Rust首先推导出以证据为依据的迁移需求规约（MRS），记录必须保留的行为和约束。然后综合出Rust设计规约（RDS），并将其实现为初始Rust项目。由于真实项目包含只有在构建和验证时才可见的实现细节和惯用法，Req2Rust将初始Rust项目视为一个可执行的精化状态。编译器、语义和unsafe削减验证器生成验证报告，以改善可构建性、行为一致性和unsafe使用。我们在通用C++项目和来自大规模Openharmony代码库的模块上，以ClaudeCode为基线对Req2Rust进行评估。Req2Rust在两种场景下都能生成可构建的Rust crate，并将测试通过率在通用项目上从69.5%提升到91.9%，在Openharmony模块上从45.4%提升到87.9%。
translation.brief: 针对项目级C++到Rust迁移中语义覆盖不足的问题，提出Req2Rust框架，通过迁移需求规约引导LLM生成Rust项目并经多验证器迭代精化。

papers.title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our this http URL platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ less time and 1.55$\times$ lower cost per completed task.

translation.title: 通往真实世界的最后一公里：作为解决真实世界任务可复用构建模块的 Agent 原生原语
translation.abstract: 拥有自身 harness 的前沿模型在真实世界基准上仍表现不佳：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，GPT-5.6 Sol 搭配 Codex 仅解决 37.3% 的任务，Claude Opus 5 搭配 Claude Code 为 51.8%。这些任务在“获取资源”到“应用资源”这一步失败，我们称之为通往真实世界的最后一公里。现有方法只是让资源触手可及，却把应用资源的能力留给调用方，因此每个 harness 都要重建这种能力。我们提出 agent 原生原语（agent-native primitives）——为资源配备一个驻留 LLM 的可复用单元，该 LLM 在上下文中应用资源并与其他原语通信——以及 HEELO（Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks），一个基于此类原语库为每个任务构建 harness 的工程框架。HEELO 将任务所需原语组合成任务专属图，依据环境证据验证结果，修订失败所涉及的原语，并在验证后接纳新的或改进的原语。我们用八个原语族实例化 HEELO，每个原语族针对一类任务，并在二十多个基准上评估。Dev-Primitives 将 Terminal-Bench 4.0 的解决率在同一骨干下从 Codex 的 37.3% 提升至 55.5%；按任务组合的 Harness Primitives 将 Terminal-Bench 2.0 的 Pass@1 从种子 harness 的 60.0% 提升至 72.2%；Tool Primitives 将 ToolBench 通过率从 55.8% 提升至 75.1%；Navigation Primitives 将 GAIA-Text-103 准确率从 45.6% 提升至 58.3%。在本 this http URL 平台的 46 个真实世界任务上，Claude Opus 5.5 搭配 Claude Code 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 搭配 Codex 各自独立完成 9 个，而通过我们的 MCP 服务器接入 HEELO 后分别完成 39 和 35 个，且每个完成任务的时间分别减少 1.9 倍和 2.3 倍，成本降低 1.55 倍。
translation.brief: 针对智能体从获取资源到应用资源的“最后一公里”能力缺失问题，提出配备驻留 LLM 的可复用 agent 原生原语及基于原语库组合、验证与演化的 harness 工程框架 HEELO。

papers.title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
papers.abstract: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctness and recompute every reported metric, the delivered strategy is checked against the hidden specification, and a run is accepted only when the user is satisfied and none of 15 veto checks fails. Across four coding agents and a model without tools in 150 sessions, no session is accepted: every session that the simulated user signed off fails a program check, and agents raise only 54--64\% of the details they were not told. Human experts attribute 88.33\% of failures to the agents. With FINCOSMOS feedback, an agent with persistent memory learned all ten tasks.

translation.title: FINCOSMOS：面向金融智能体的开放世界评估范式
translation.abstract: 语言智能体越来越多地在开放 Web 上为用户工作，而金融是最难信任它们的领域。数据必须来自 Web，策略存在于用户脑中，正确性依赖于时间，因此智能体可能静默失败：用户从未要求的策略、未经验证的数据，或使用未来数据的回测，都会产生与正确报告同样有说服力的结果。现有基准在某个地方封闭了世界——固定任务、数据或时间线——从而消除了这些失败而非度量它们。我们提出 FINCOSMOS，一个针对从事金融工作的智能体的开放世界评估范式。一个模拟用户持有从组合文法中采样的隐藏策略，且仅在被问及时才透露。智能体不获得任何数据，必须从 Web 获取数据，在数据截止约束下构建自己的回测，并交付可验证的结果。评分无需参考答案：程序验证时点正确性并重算每个报告的指标，交付的策略与隐藏规范比对，只有当用户满意且 15 项否决检查全部通过时，一次运行才被接受。在四个编码智能体和一个无工具模型共 150 个会话中，没有任何会话被接受：每个模拟用户签字通过的会话都未通过程序检查，且智能体仅提出 54–64% 的未被告知的细节。人类专家将 88.33% 的失败归因于智能体。借助 FINCOSMOS 的反馈，一个具有持久记忆的智能体学会了全部十个任务。
translation.brief: 针对金融智能体在开放 Web 环境下可能静默失败而现有基准无法度量的问题，提出由模拟用户、隐藏策略与程序化验证构成的开放世界评估范式 FINCOSMOS。

papers.title: Polynomial-Time Approximate EFX for Chores via Flow and Matching
papers.abstract: We study approximate EFX allocations of indivisible chores under nonnegative additive costs. Exact EFX allocations need not exist in general. We develop a polynomial-time algorithm that computes a complete $(3+\varepsilon)$-EFX allocation for any rational $0<\varepsilon\leq1$, improving the previous approximation guarantee from a factor depending on the number of agents to a constant. The algorithm extends to EF$k$X, achieving a $(2+1/k+\varepsilon)$-approximation for every integer $k\geq1$. For instances with relatively few chores, the polynomial-time BRBI algorithm gives stronger guarantees. It finds exact EF$k$X allocations when $m\leq2kn$ and achieves a factor of at most $2-1/k$ when $m\le(3k-1)n$. In particular, $k=1$ and $m\leq2n$ give exact EFX. We further show that the approximation factor \(2+1/k\) is asymptotically tight for our main algorithm. We also construct a four-agent, ten-chore instance in which every complete allocation has EFX approximation factor at least $11/10$, improving upon the $20/19$ lower bound for submodular costs even under additive costs.

translation.title: 基于流与匹配的不可分家务多项式时间近似 EFX 分配
translation.abstract: 我们研究非负可加成本下不可分家务的近似 EFX 分配。精确 EFX 分配在一般情况下未必存在。我们开发了一个多项式时间算法，对任意有理数 0<ε≤1 计算完整的 (3+ε)-EFX 分配，将之前的近似保证从依赖于智能体数量的因子改进为常数。该算法可扩展至 EFkX，对每个整数 k≥1 达到 (2+1/k+ε) 的近似。对于家务数量相对较少的实例，多项式时间算法 BRBI 给出更强的保证：当 m≤2kn 时找到精确 EFkX 分配，当 m≤(3k-1)n 时达到至多 2-1/k 的因子。特别地，k=1 且 m≤2n 时给出精确 EFX。我们进一步证明 2+1/k 的近似因子对我们的主算法是渐近紧的。我们还构造了一个四智能体、十家务的实例，其中每个完整分配的 EFX 近似因子至少为 11/10，即使在可加成本下也改进了次模成本下 20/19 的下界。
translation.brief: 针对不可分家务的近似 EFX 分配问题，提出基于流与匹配的多项式时间算法，实现常数因子 (3+ε)-EFX 保证。

papers.title: Localization Does Not Imply Steerability: A Mechanistic Study of Sign Errors in LLM Mathematics
papers.abstract: When large language models do multi-step mathematics, a characteristic failure recurs: the model writes one wrong sign token mid-computation -- a cofactor sign, the minus of a recursive integration-by-parts step -- then executes the rest of the arithmetic correctly, and the answer comes out wrong. We ask where inside the network that sign is written. Across six open models spanning 14B to 675B parameters, a per-layer readout shows the wrong sign is committed late -- by MLP layers in the last quarter of the network (70-100% per model and task), a pattern present, where tested (Qwen), in the base model before instruction tuning. The mechanism varies: some models carry fixed "minus-stamp" layers that push a minus regardless of the right answer, others carry amplifiers of whichever sign was already chosen, and Qwen adds a downstream rescue layer that opposes the stamp. The circuit is causal: subtracting a single sign direction from the residual stream flips 13 of 14 held-out minus-written integration-by-parts errors on Llama-3.3-70B, with flips replicating on Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral-Small (24-70% per cell), and with representation-level specificity -- the same dose breaks correctly-minus answers while sparing correct-plus answers where the direction is surgical (0/72 on Llama), and matched random-direction and control-layer interventions are null. Core claims were preregistered with pass criteria frozen in git before held-out data was seen: 23 of 29 checks passed, all misses reported. But causality is not uniform: Phi-4 implements an equally well-localized circuit at the same late depth, yet the identical intervention flips almost nothing -- the sign is written redundantly across ~15 layers with margins several times larger (median 17.8 logits). Localization, we conclude, does not imply steerability: two models can share a circuit location yet differ enormously in how overturnable it is.

translation.title: 定位不等于可操控性：LLM 数学中符号错误的机制研究
translation.abstract: 当大语言模型进行多步数学运算时，一种特征性失败反复出现：模型在计算中途写下一个错误的符号 token——一个余子式符号、递归分部积分步骤中的负号——然后正确执行其余算术，但最终答案错误。我们追问这个符号在网络内部的何处被写入。在六个参数量从 14B 到 675B 的开源模型上，逐层读出显示错误符号是晚期提交的——由网络最后四分之一的 MLP 层（每个模型和任务 70-100%），且在测试过的模型（Qwen）中，该模式在指令微调之前的基础模型中即已存在。机制各不相同：一些模型携带固定的“负号盖章”层，无论正确答案如何都推入负号；另一些模型携带放大已选符号的放大器；Qwen 还增加了一个对抗盖章的下游救援层。该电路是因果的：在 Llama-3.3-70B 上，从残差流中减去单个符号方向可翻转 14 个 held-out 写负号的分部积分错误中的 13 个，翻转在 Qwen、Gemma 和 Mistral-Small 上可复现（每格 24-70%），且具有表示层面的特异性——当方向足够精准时，相同剂量会破坏正确的负号答案而不影响正确的正号答案（Llama 上 0/72），而匹配的随机方向和对照层干预均为无效。核心主张在看到 held-out 数据之前已预注册并通过 git 冻结通过标准：29 项检查中 23 项通过，所有未通过项均已报告。但因果性并不一致：Phi-4 在相同的晚期深度实现了同样良好定位的电路，然而相同的干预几乎不产生翻转——符号以数倍更大的裕度（中位数 17.8 logits）在约 15 层中冗余写入。我们的结论是：定位不意味着可操控性——两个模型可以共享电路位置，但在其可推翻程度上差异巨大。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 多步数学中符号错误的内部机制问题，通过逐层读出与因果干预定位到晚期 MLP 层，并发现电路定位并不保证可操控性。

papers.title: Signed but Not Safe: Requirement Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
papers.abstract: Enterprise AI agents increasingly split a user's request across subagents and merge their results, and each handoff can summarize away, alter or ignore a requirement. We report a preregistered study with synthetic, exactly scorable tasks comparing free-text, structured JSON and signed requirement-manifest handoffs: the orchestrator extracts each requirement as a verbatim quote plus a checkable predicate, code signs the manifest with HMAC-SHA256, and deterministic code verifies the merger's decision. With Qwen3-8B (1,440 trajectories, five threats), signed manifests cut unsafe commits under attack from 69.4% to 9.0% (60.4 pp, 95% CI [51.4, 69.4]) with no net loss of conformant commits relative to structured handoffs. Signing is what defeats in-transit tampering: an unsigned manifest committed violations in 79% of mutated runs, the signed one in none. On identical trajectories the deterministic verifier caught 78.7% of violating decisions versus 59.0% for an LLM checker, with 7% versus 50% false alarms. An oracle manifest removed all remaining unsafe commits: the residual risk comes from extraction errors made before signing. A preregistered pre-signing injection attack confirmed this boundary: one adversarial line raised signed-manifest violations from 14.6% to 37.5% (Qwen3-8B), 11.1% to 63.9% (gpt-oss-20b) and 8.3% to 75.0% (GPT-5.6-luna), and the signature then authenticated the corrupted manifest. Signing protects requirements in transit, not at extraction; the extraction step is the trust boundary.

translation.title: 已签名但不安全：多智能体 LLM 交接中的需求完整性
translation.abstract: 企业级 AI 智能体越来越多地将用户请求拆分给子智能体并合并其结果，而每次交接都可能概括掉、篡改或忽略某项需求。我们报告一项预注册研究，使用可精确评分的合成任务比较自由文本、结构化 JSON 和签名需求清单三种交接方式：编排器将每项需求提取为逐字引用加可检查谓词，代码用 HMAC-SHA256 对清单签名，确定性代码验证合并方的决策。使用 Qwen3-8B（1,440 条轨迹，五种威胁）时，签名清单将攻击下的不安全提交从 69.4% 降至 9.0%（60.4 个百分点，95% CI [51.4, 69.4]），且相对于结构化交接没有合规提交的净损失。签名正是击败传输中篡改的关键：未签名清单在 79% 的被篡改运行中提交了违规，而签名清单为零。在相同轨迹上，确定性验证器捕获了 78.7% 的违规决策，而 LLM 检查器为 59.0%，误报率分别为 7% 和 50%。一个 oracle 清单消除了所有剩余的不安全提交：残余风险来自签名之前的提取错误。一项预注册的签名前注入攻击证实了这一边界：一行对抗性文本将签名清单的违规率从 14.6% 提高到 37.5%（Qwen3-8B）、11.1% 到 63.9%（gpt-oss-20b）、8.3% 到 75.0%（GPT-5.6-luna），且签名随后认证了被污染的清单。签名保护的是传输中的需求，而非提取环节；提取步骤才是信任边界。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体交接中需求被篡改或丢失的问题，提出 HMAC 签名需求清单加确定性验证的方案，并揭示签名只保护传输环节、提取步骤才是真正的信任边界。

papers.title: MEvince: Knowledge-Constrained LLM Reasoning for Technique Identification from Malware Reports
papers.abstract: Mapping behavioral intelligence in malware analysis reports to ATT&CK techniques supports threat analysis and defense, but reliable identification remains challenging. Supporting evidence is often scattered across long, heterogeneous reports, while closely related techniques share behavioral cues and differ only in subtle but decisive details. While large language models (LLMs) can use external knowledge to interpret reports, they may assign techniques based on plausible associations rather than sufficient evidence. We present MEvince, a knowledge-constrained LLM reasoning framework for report-level malware technique identification. Its core is a shared behavioral representation connecting report observations to technique definitions. This representation is built through agentic mining of technique documentation and supports two online stages: 1) primitive-guided extraction uses behavioral primitives to structure LLM-extracted observations, link them to source passages, and group dispersed evidence; 2) evidence-aligned retrieval matches this evidence to technique profiles through the same concepts, retaining likely candidates and confusable alternatives for LLM comparison of distinguishing behaviors. Controls at both stages validate evidence references and check technique-specific requirements. The representation also supports adaptation without parameter updates, where offline agentic audits diagnose concept weaknesses and refine extraction or retrieval policies. We evaluate MEvince against 11 baselines spanning four method families using a dataset of 610 public malware reports referenced by MITRE ATT&CK. MEvince improves exact-ID F1 over the strongest baseline by 17.4%, and its concept-guided retrieval increases gold-label candidate coverage from 31.6% to 47.9%. With a small adaptation set, offline refinement yields further gains and outperforms baselines that update model parameters.

translation.title: MEvince：面向恶意软件报告技术识别的知识约束LLM推理
translation.abstract: 将恶意软件分析报告中的行为智能映射到ATT&CK技术有助于威胁分析与防御，但可靠识别仍具挑战性。支持性证据往往分散在长且异构的报告中，而密切相关的技术共享行为线索，仅在细微但决定性的细节上有所不同。虽然大语言模型（LLM）可以利用外部知识解读报告，但它们可能基于貌似合理的关联而非充分证据来分配技术。我们提出MEvince，一个用于报告级恶意软件技术识别的知识约束LLM推理框架。其核心是连接报告观察与技术定义的共享行为表示。该表示通过对技术文档的agentic挖掘构建，并支持两个在线阶段：1）原语引导抽取使用行为原语结构化LLM抽取的观察，将其链接到源文本段落，并对分散的证据进行分组；2）证据对齐检索通过相同概念将证据与技术画像匹配，保留可能的候选技术和易混淆的替代技术，供LLM比较区分性行为。两个阶段的控制机制验证证据引用并检查技术特定要求。该表示还支持无需参数更新的自适应：离线agentic审计诊断概念弱点并改进抽取或检索策略。我们在MITRE ATT&CK引用的610份公开恶意软件报告数据集上，将MEvince与涵盖四类方法家族的11个基线进行评估。MEvince将exact-ID F1较最强基线提升17.4%，其概念引导检索将金标候选覆盖率从31.6%提升至47.9%。使用小型自适应集，离线改进带来进一步提升，并优于更新模型参数的基线。
translation.brief: 解决从恶意软件报告中可靠识别ATT&CK技术的问题，核心方法是通过共享行为表示连接报告观察与技术定义，并用原语引导抽取和证据对齐检索约束LLM推理。

papers.title: ReviewMap: Mapping Evaluative Acts and Automation Boundaries in Peer-Review Comments
papers.abstract: Peer-review comments check what a paper does and judge why it matters, but no existing scheme distinguishes these two evaluative acts. We argue that making these acts explicit and measuring how reliably LLMs identify them is a prerequisite for responsible LLM-assisted review analysis: humans need to inspect review judgments and their grounds. This defines a more honest mission for NLP in peer review than full automation. We present ReviewMap, a framework that classifies each comment as assessment of claims and scholarly standards or calibration of contribution value and venue fit, with finer-grained attributes applied conditionally by act type. Applied to 500 ICLR~2026 papers through multi-model LLM consensus, the act layer proves reliably automatable under the operational guideline (inter-model $\kappa \geq 0.75$), supported by five-human validation on 470 development comments, while the attribute layer requires human oversight, defining a measured automation boundary. At the corpus level, 17% of reviewer-paper instances contain no panel-coded calibration, and the panel-coded calibration share is nearly $3\times$ as high in Strengths as in Weaknesses. This boundary informs three affordances: a review guideline that operationalizes the assessment-then-calibration workflow for reviewers, a per-comment rebuttal strategy scaffold for authors, and a discussion-phase dashboard for area chairs.

translation.title: ReviewMap：映射同行评审评论中的评价行为与自动化边界
translation.abstract: 同行评审评论既检查论文做了什么，也判断其为何重要，但现有方案均未区分这两种评价行为。我们认为，显式化这些行为并衡量LLM识别它们的可靠性，是负责任地使用LLM辅助评审分析的前提：人类需要审查评审判断及其依据。这为NLP在同行评审中定义了比完全自动化更诚实的使命。我们提出ReviewMap，一个将每条评论分类为对论断和学术标准的评估（assessment）或对贡献价值和会议契合度的校准（calibration）的框架，并按行为类型有条件地应用更细粒度的属性。通过多模型LLM共识应用于500篇ICLR 2026论文，行为层在操作准则下可可靠自动化（模型间κ≥0.75），并得到对470条开发评论的五人验证支持，而属性层需要人类监督，从而界定了一个可度量的自动化边界。在语料库层面，17%的评审者-论文实例不含面板编码的校准，且面板编码的校准在Strengths中的占比几乎是Weaknesses中的3倍。该边界支撑三项功能：为评审者提供操作化“先评估后校准”工作流的评审指南，为作者提供逐条评论的rebuttal策略支架，为领域主席提供讨论阶段仪表盘。
translation.brief: 解决区分同行评审评论中“评估”与“校准”两类评价行为并确定LLM自动化边界的问题，核心方法是提出ReviewMap分类框架并用多模型共识与人类验证度量各层的可自动化性。

papers.title: Transparency in Team Contracts
papers.abstract: In contract design, the principal is often better informed about the project's chances of succeeding than the agents. To incentivize effort, the principal has two main tools: first, to design a contract, sharing part of the project's success among the agents; second, to design a (Bayesian) persuasion scheme, selectively sharing information with the agents. In this work we are interested in the optimal combination of both these tools. We tackle the joint problem through the prism of simplicity vs. optimality, and establish a stark dichotomy: The simple disclosure scheme of full transparency achieves a tight $4/3$-approximation to the optimal combination of information disclosure and team contract, when the team's production function is submodular. In contrast, full transparency can be arbitrarily far from optimal when production is supermodular. The techniques that we develop to bound the gap for submodular functions, also yield a new deterministic polynomial-time approximation algorithm for pure multi-agent contract design, with a significantly improved approximation ratio of $2.311$, and thus a $3.081$-approximation algorithm for the joint information and contracting problem.

translation.title: 团队合同中的透明度
translation.abstract: 在合同设计中，委托人往往比代理人更了解项目成功的概率。为激励努力，委托人主要有两种工具：一是设计合同，将项目成功的部分收益分配给代理人；二是设计（贝叶斯）说服方案，有选择地向代理人共享信息。本文关注这两种工具的最优组合。我们通过简单性与最优性的视角处理这一联合问题，并建立了一个鲜明的二分法：当团队的生产函数为次模（submodular）时，完全透明的简单披露方案可达到信息披露与团队合同最优组合的紧致4/3近似；相反，当生产为超模（supermodular）时，完全透明可能任意偏离最优。我们为界定次模函数差距而开发的技术，还产生了纯多代理人合同设计的新确定性多项式时间近似算法，近似比显著改进至2.311，从而得到信息与合同联合问题的3.081近似算法。
translation.brief: 解决委托人同时使用合同设计与信息说服激励团队时的最优组合问题，核心方法是通过次模/超模生产函数的二分分析证明完全透明的近似保证并改进多代理人合同近似算法。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Agent Orchestration:Higher-Order Interactions in Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Learned orchestration has emerged as a promising paradigm for large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, in which a central orchestrator selects agents and controls the information they receive throughout a task. Despite rapid empirical progress, existing methods train the orchestrator by crediting each decision with its own advantage, implicitly assuming that the other decisions in the episode stay fixed. This assumption fails in orchestration, where the contribution of each decision to the final outcome depends on the decisions preceding it, so the gain of a joint update is not the sum of its per-decision effects. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{IAPO}, an interaction-aware policy optimization framework that explicitly accounts for interactions among decisions. Specifically, IAPO exactly decomposes the performance difference between two policies into the effects of individual decisions and their interactions, which we prove can account for half of the attainable gain, and then optimizes both from sampled trajectories while certifying that every update is an improvement. On long-input versions of GSM8K, MATH, DROP, MBPP and HumanEval, against fifteen published multi-agent and workflow-search systems on the same 7B executor, IAPO's deployed plans reach the strongest system's accuracy with fewer tokens, and removing the interaction term costs 7 to 17 points of accuracy on code.

translation.title: 学习多智能体编排：策略改进中的高阶交互
translation.abstract: 学习式编排已成为基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统的有前景范式，其中中央编排器在任务全程选择智能体并控制其接收的信息。尽管实证进展迅速，现有方法通过将每个决策记入其自身优势来训练编排器，隐式假设回合中其他决策保持不变。这一假设在编排中不成立，因为每个决策对最终结果的贡献取决于其之前的决策，因此联合更新的增益并非各决策效应之和。为应对这一挑战，我们提出IAPO，一个显式考虑决策间交互的交互感知策略优化框架。具体而言，IAPO将两个策略之间的性能差异精确分解为个体决策效应及其交互效应，我们证明交互效应可占可获得增益的一半，然后从采样轨迹中同时优化两者，并证明每次更新都是改进。在GSM8K、MATH、DROP、MBPP和HumanEval的长输入版本上，与十五个已发表的多智能体和工作流搜索系统在同一7B执行器上对比，IAPO部署的计划以更少token达到最强系统的准确率，且移除交互项会使代码任务准确率下降7至17个百分点。
translation.brief: 解决LLM多智能体编排训练中忽略决策间交互导致的信用分配偏差问题，核心方法是提出IAPO，将策略间性能差异精确分解为个体决策效应与交互效应并同时优化。

papers.title: DelegateEval: Evaluating Platforms for Personal External Service Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents that work for an individual over time may also help that individual serve external clients. We define a personal external service agent as an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to accept client requests, deliver work, and provide ongoing support using that person's knowledge, experience, professional methods, and service boundaries. Such agents could allow individuals to serve more clients with less direct involvement and generate economic value at scale. We propose DelegateEval, a platform-level evaluation framework for agent systems that may combine large language models, reusable skills, protocols such as MCP, and executable tool environments. It covers eight dimensions: ease of creation, service discovery and matching, delivery quality, expertise inheritance, service continuity, learning and improvement, reliability and governance, and efficiency and value. These dimensions assess whether a platform enables people with different backgrounds to turn their expertise into ongoing services that deliver verifiable work, develop capabilities through experience, and remain economically feasible. We present the framework and an experimental design. Complete datasets, executable environments, a unified scoring protocol, and cross-model results remain to be developed and empirically validated.

translation.title: DelegateEval：个人外部服务智能体平台评估
translation.abstract: 长期为个人工作的AI智能体也可帮助该个人服务外部客户。我们将个人外部服务智能体定义为：由特定个人授权并持续管理的智能体，利用该人的知识、经验、专业方法和服务边界，接受客户请求、交付工作并提供持续支持。此类智能体可使个人以更少的直接参与服务更多客户，并规模化创造经济价值。我们提出DelegateEval，一个面向可能结合大语言模型、可复用技能、MCP等协议及可执行工具环境的智能体系统的平台级评估框架。它涵盖八个维度：创建便捷性、服务发现与匹配、交付质量、专业知识传承、服务连续性、学习与改进、可靠性与治理、效率与价值。这些维度评估平台能否使不同背景的人将自身专长转化为可交付可验证工作的持续服务、通过经验发展能力并保持经济可行性。我们给出该框架和实验设计。完整数据集、可执行环境、统一评分协议及跨模型结果尚待开发与实证验证。
translation.brief: 解决如何系统评估个人外部服务智能体平台的问题，核心方法是提出涵盖八个维度的平台级评估框架DelegateEval及其实验设计。

papers.title: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion with Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Scenarios
papers.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code, which closely aligns with the practical needs of real-world software development, has sparked growing attention in repository-level code completion. However, existing Code LLMs present challenges in focusing on suitable contexts from the repository and in deeply reasoning about cross-file dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion. To better understand both in-file and cross-file contexts, we employ identifier-driven intent recognition to capture completion intent, thereby improving the model's performance in real-world scenarios. To enhance cross-file reasoning, we propose a reward-driven completion learning to effectively reward in complex repository completion scenarios. To guide LLMs in completing code that aligns with intended functionality and repository context, we introduce a selective-exploration strategy that directs the model to focus on low-confidence, high-reward tokens, promoting the exploration of valuable, underexplored completion patterns. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of Code LLMs. The code and the dataset are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 基于强化学习在真实场景中增强仓库级代码补全
translation.abstract: 面向代码的大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，与真实软件开发实际需求高度契合，引发了人们对仓库级代码补全的日益关注。然而，现有的 Code LLM 在从仓库中聚焦合适上下文以及对跨文件依赖进行深度推理方面存在挑战。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的仓库级代码补全强化学习框架。为了更好地理解文件内和跨文件上下文，我们采用标识符驱动的意图识别来捕捉补全意图，从而提升模型在真实场景中的表现。为增强跨文件推理，我们提出奖励驱动的补全学习，以在复杂的仓库补全场景中有效给予奖励。为引导 LLM 补全符合预期功能和仓库上下文的代码，我们引入了一种选择性探索策略，使模型聚焦于低置信度、高奖励的 token，促进对有价值且探索不足的补全模式的探索。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著提升了 Code LLM 的性能。代码和数据集可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对仓库级代码补全中上下文聚焦和跨文件依赖推理不足的问题，提出结合标识符驱动意图识别、奖励驱动学习与选择性探索策略的强化学习框架。

papers.title: OptST: Optimizing Semantic Tokenization for LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
papers.abstract: Semantic information can enrich the identifiers and structured fields used by recommender systems. Semantic tokenization provides a structured representation of this information by converting LLM-derived user profiles into discrete tokens. In the common two-stage pipeline, the tokenizer is trained before the recommender. Its token assignments are then treated as fixed input features during recommendation training. As a result, the downstream recommender can learn how to use the assigned indices, but it cannot revise the semantic partition that produced them. Making this partition task-aware is difficult because nearest-code assignment is discrete, and unconstrained adaptation may also distort the geometry learned during pretraining. Moreover, a fixed token depth exposes the same semantic resolution to every interaction. We thus propose OptST (Optimizing Semantic Tokenization), which makes a pretrained tokenizer responsive to downstream recommendation. To revise token assignments without directly updating the pretrained encoder or base codebooks, OptST learns a low-rank deformation whose drift is limited by an anchor regularizer. Recommendation supervision reaches this transformation through a straight-through estimator, while prediction retains hard nearest-code assignments. Beyond adapting the assignments themselves, OptST selects an interaction-conditioned prefix to control how much residual detail is exposed to the recommender. Experiments on four public datasets show that OptST achieves the highest AUC among conventional and LLM-enhanced baselines. Its improvements also persist across different recommendation backbones. These results establish task-aware semantic tokenization as an effective interface between LLM-derived profiles and downstream recommendation models.

translation.title: OptST：面向 LLM 增强推荐优化语义分词
translation.abstract: 语义信息可以丰富推荐系统所使用的标识符和结构化字段。语义分词通过将 LLM 生成的用户画像转换为离散 token，为这些信息提供结构化表示。在常见的两阶段流水线中，分词器先于推荐器训练，其 token 分配在推荐训练期间被视为固定的输入特征。因此，下游推荐器可以学习如何使用分配的索引，但无法修改产生这些索引的语义划分。使该划分具备任务感知能力很困难，因为最近邻码本分配是离散的，且无约束的自适应也可能扭曲预训练期间学到的几何结构。此外，固定的 token 深度使每次交互都暴露相同的语义分辨率。因此，我们提出 OptST（Optimizing Semantic Tokenization），使预训练分词器能够响应下游推荐。为在不直接更新预训练编码器或基础码本的情况下修改 token 分配，OptST 学习一种低秩形变，其漂移受锚点正则化约束。推荐监督通过直通估计器作用于该变换，同时预测仍保留硬性最近邻码本分配。除了自适应调整分配本身，OptST 还选择基于交互条件的前缀来控制向推荐器暴露多少残差细节。在四个公开数据集上的实验表明，OptST 在传统和 LLM 增强基线中取得了最高的 AUC。其改进在不同推荐骨干上也持续存在。这些结果确立了任务感知语义分词作为 LLM 生成画像与下游推荐模型之间有效接口的地位。
translation.brief: 针对两阶段推荐流水线中语义分词划分无法感知下游任务的问题，提出通过低秩形变加锚点正则化和直通估计器使预训练分词器可被推荐监督自适应调整的 OptST 方法。

papers.title: Goal-Branching LaCAM: Temporary Goals as Search Branches in Dense Multi-Agent Pathfinding
papers.abstract: LaCAM is a search-based solver for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) that runs a depth-first search over joint configurations, using PIBT to generate successors and lazily adding single-agent constraints to explore alternatives. Although LaCAM is complete, it can struggle on dense, corridor-heavy instances because extracting blocking agents from deadlocks requires coordinated moves of several agents, often away from their goals, which PIBT's greedy one-step successors rarely propose and which LaCAM can only reach by enumerating constraints one agent at a time. This paper proposes Goal-Branching, where blocking agents are given temporary goals, each tried as an additional branch of LaCAM's search. We examine random and corridor-aware rules for choosing these temporary goals and show that completeness is preserved for any such rule. On dense instances (60-90% of free cells occupied) of three maze and room maps, Goal-Branching solves 89% of instances against 44% for LaCAM*, and, on instances both solve, it finds a first solution 10-14x faster on maze-32-32-2 and room-32-32-4, and nearly 200x faster in median time at 75% density on room-32-32-4. Solution cost increases by 15-22% on instances both solve, while on open maps and the full MovingAI benchmark its solutions cost no more than those of LaCAM* and it is at most 3% slower.

translation.title: Goal-Branching LaCAM：在密集多智能体路径规划中将临时目标作为搜索分支
translation.abstract: LaCAM 是一种基于搜索的多智能体路径规划（MAPF）求解器，它在联合配置上运行深度优先搜索，使用 PIBT 生成后继节点，并通过惰性添加单智能体约束来探索替代方案。尽管 LaCAM 是完备的，但在密集、多走廊的实例上可能表现不佳，因为从死锁中提取阻塞智能体需要多个智能体的协同移动，往往需要偏离各自目标，而 PIBT 的贪心单步后继很少提出这种移动，LaCAM 只能通过逐个枚举约束来达到。本文提出 Goal-Branching，即为阻塞智能体赋予临时目标，并将每个临时目标作为 LaCAM 搜索的额外分支进行尝试。我们研究了选择这些临时目标的随机规则和走廊感知规则，并证明对任何此类规则完备性均得以保持。在三张迷宫和房间地图的密集实例（空闲格子占用率 60-90%）上，Goal-Branching 解决了 89% 的实例，而 LaCAM* 仅为 44%；在两者都能解决的实例上，它在 maze-32-32-2 和 room-32-32-4 上找到首个解的速度快 10-14 倍，在 room-32-32-4 上 75% 密度时的中位时间快近 200 倍。在两者都能解决的实例上，解的成本增加 15-22%，而在开阔地图和完整 MovingAI 基准上，其解的成本不高于 LaCAM*，且最多慢 3%。
translation.brief: 针对 LaCAM 在密集多智能体路径规划中难以化解死锁的问题，提出为阻塞智能体赋予临时目标并将其作为额外搜索分支的 Goal-Branching 方法。

papers.title: JailBound: FOL-Guided Jailbreak Evaluation for Exploring LLM Behavioral Boundaries
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as general-purpose conversational assistants, they must handle diverse user requests while reliably refusing harmful ones. Jailbreak attacks craft adversarial instructions or conversational contexts to elicit unsafe responses despite these safeguards. However, existing jailbreak benchmarks often rely on manually designed or collected prompts, making it difficult to systematically extend coverage to new threat conditions. Moreover, existing attack search methods typically optimize for attack success rate (ASR), providing limited insight into how model behavior changes locally between safe refusal and unsafe response. To address these limitations, we present JailBound, a unified jailbreak evaluation framework that combines automated benchmark construction with first-order loss (FOL)-guided dual-branch search. JailBound organizes threats by risk category, application domain, and attack type. Conditioned on this taxonomy, a fine-tuned meta-attack generator synthesizes evaluation prompts across diverse threat conditions. FOL serves as a local sensitivity signal for exploring high-value attack states and behavior-sensitive states. We evaluate JailBound across 46 LLMs from 13 model families under a unified experimental protocol. Under matched settings, the High-Value Branch improves average ASR over a ZOL-only baseline by 5.1 and 4.9 percentage points across the two evaluation settings. Under local perturbations, states from the Safety-Sensitivity Branch exhibit higher behavioral flip rates than those from the High-Value Branch across all tested radii for JailBound and S-Eval, indicating greater local sensitivity of judge-assigned safety labels. Warning: this paper includes examples that may be offensive or harmful.

translation.title: JailBound：FOL 引导的越狱评估用于探索 LLM 行为边界
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为通用对话助手，它们必须处理多样化的用户请求，同时可靠地拒绝有害请求。越狱攻击通过构造对抗性指令或对话上下文来绕过这些防护，诱使模型产生不安全响应。然而，现有的越狱基准通常依赖人工设计或收集的提示，难以系统性地扩展覆盖新的威胁条件。此外，现有的攻击搜索方法通常以攻击成功率（ASR）为优化目标，对模型行为在安全拒绝与不安全响应之间如何局部变化提供的洞察有限。为解决这些局限，我们提出 JailBound，一个将自动化基准构建与一阶损失（FOL）引导的双分支搜索相结合的统一越狱评估框架。JailBound 按风险类别、应用领域和攻击类型组织威胁。基于该分类体系，微调的元攻击生成器在多样威胁条件下合成评估提示。FOL 作为局部敏感性信号，用于探索高价值攻击状态和行为敏感状态。我们在统一实验协议下对来自 13 个模型家族的 46 个 LLM 进行评估。在匹配设置下，高价值分支在两种评估设置中相比仅用 ZOL 的基线将平均 ASR 分别提升 5.1 和 4.9 个百分点。在局部扰动下，安全敏感性分支的状态在所有测试半径上均比高价值分支的状态表现出更高的行为翻转率，表明 judge 分配的安全标签具有更大的局部敏感性。警告：本文包含可能具有冒犯性或有害性的示例。
translation.brief: 针对越狱基准覆盖扩展难且现有攻击搜索缺乏对模型行为局部边界洞察的问题，提出结合自动化基准构建与 FOL 引导双分支搜索的 JailBound 评估框架。

papers.title: Route Before Response: Fail-Closed Routing for LLM-Enabled Customer-Service Software
papers.abstract: LLM-enabled customer-service software in financial institutions must choose a downstream service before responding. Classifiers and LLM routers can identify a relevant label or destination, but a composed application must still verify dispatch permission and entity registration. We study this integration problem as boundary-aware pre-response routing. We present RouteBR, a controller in which one model call proposes a primary service action and registered object, then deterministic code checks identifiers and versioned rules before dispatch or a specified non-dispatch outcome. Lower-ranked candidates cannot replace a blocked primary route. We construct 600 privacy-preserving scenarios from recurring confidential-request patterns at a real financial institution; three engineers jointly reviewed the scenarios and labels. On the 200-case CONFIRM MAIN split, RouteBR reaches 97.5% final-path exact match. A matched one-call baseline given the same rules reaches 95.5%, whereas a diagnostic baseline without the rule program obtains 94.0% action accuracy but only 41.0% final-path exact match. Across 166 non-dispatch MAIN and FLIP cases, RouteBR produces no false dispatch. The artifact pairs all 1,960 prediction rows with raw receipts while excluding gold and reviewer fields from model requests. These results support separating model proposals from code-owned, replayable execution. Our implementation is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 先路由后响应：面向 LLM 客服软件的故障关闭式路由
translation.abstract: 金融机构中启用 LLM 的客服软件必须在响应前选择下游服务。分类器和 LLM 路由器可以识别相关标签或目的地，但组合式应用仍需验证分发权限和实体注册。我们将这一集成问题研究为边界感知的响应前路由。我们提出 RouteBR，一个控制器，其中一次模型调用提出主要服务动作和注册对象，然后确定性代码在分发或指定的不分发结果之前检查标识符和版本化规则。低排名候选无法替代被阻止的主路由。我们从某真实金融机构反复出现的机密请求模式构建了 600 个隐私保护场景；三名工程师共同审查了场景和标签。在 200 例的 CONFIRM MAIN 划分上，RouteBR 达到 97.5% 的最终路径精确匹配率。在相同规则下，匹配的单次调用基线达到 95.5%，而没有规则程序的诊断基线获得 94.0% 的动作准确率，但最终路径精确匹配率仅为 41.0%。在 166 个不分发 MAIN 和 FLIP 案例中，RouteBR 没有产生任何错误分发。该工件将全部 1,960 行预测与原始回执配对，同时从模型请求中排除金标和审查者字段。这些结果支持将模型提议与代码拥有的、可重放的执行相分离。我们的实现可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 客服软件响应前路由中权限与实体校验不可靠的问题，提出模型提议与确定性代码校验相分离的故障关闭式路由控制器 RouteBR。

papers.title: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both the prefill and decode phases. FlashOffloading builds rolling HBM cache for prefill, a hot cache for decode, a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead, and a compute--load overlapped kernel, optimizing KV offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO). In experiments deploying GLM-5.2 with multi-token prediction (MTP3) speculative decoding on an Ascend910C prefill--decode (PD)-disaggregated platform, FlashOffloading improves prefill throughput by up to 1.38\(\times\) and decode throughput by up to 1.91\(\times\) under a 30 ms TPOT constraint. FlashOffloading is integrated into an open-source serving framework: this https URL.

translation.title: FlashOffloading：面向长上下文 LLM 服务的低延迟 KV Cache 卸载
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）服务系统中，键值（KV）缓存随序列长度和并发数线性增长，因此长上下文推理很容易触及高带宽内存（HBM）的容量瓶颈，导致低并发。将 KV cache 卸载到主机动态随机存取内存（DRAM）可以释放 HBM 空间并提高并发，但额外的缓存管理和主机到设备（H2D）加载开销会推高推理延迟，使更高的并发无法转化为有效吞吐量。我们提出 FlashOffloading，一种以主机 DRAM 为中心的推理架构，在 prefill 和 decode 两个阶段都完全卸载 KV cache。FlashOffloading 为 prefill 构建滚动 HBM 缓存，为 decode 构建热缓存，设计了零额外 miss 查找开销的反向稀疏索引，以及计算-加载重叠的 kernel，在整个流水线上优化 KV 卸载延迟，并在单输出 token 时间（TPOT）服务级目标（SLO）约束下带来吞吐量提升。在 Ascend910C prefill-decode（PD）分离平台上部署带多 token 预测（MTP3）投机解码的 GLM-5.2 的实验中，在 30 ms TPOT 约束下，FlashOffloading 将 prefill 吞吐量最高提升 1.38 倍，decode 吞吐量最高提升 1.91 倍。FlashOffloading 已集成到开源服务框架中：this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 挤占 HBM 导致低并发的问题，核心方法是以主机 DRAM 为中心的全量 KV 卸载架构，结合滚动/热缓存、反向稀疏索引和计算-加载重叠 kernel 降低卸载延迟。

papers.title: OptIMerge: Optimization-Based Merging of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: The arithmetic merging of weights from multiple task-specific models fine-tuned from a shared base model, commonly known as model souping, has emerged as a popular strategy for multi-task learning without the computational overhead of joint retraining. However, naive scalar weight averaging frequently leads to severe performance degradation when the constituent models learn structurally divergent feature representations, leading to destructive parameter interference. We study this problem in a largely unexplored setting: merging image-to-image (I2I) diffusion models fine-tuned for dense, pixel-accurate tasks such as image restoration. Unlike the large language models (LLMs) and text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models for which most merging methods were developed, I2I experts encode conflicting spatial priors (e.g., anisotropic motion-blur vs. isotropic defocus-blur) in their convolutional filters, where both naive soup and LLM-style element-wise merging introduce visible artifacts. We introduce OptIMerge, a gradient-based optimization framework: instead of relying on heuristic scalars, OptIMerge learns highly expressive, yet parameter-efficient merger coefficients by minimizing a multi-task diffusion loss over a small set of 100-500 images. OptIMerge parameterizes the merge with architecture-aware transformations: for attention layers, a structured low-rank feature alignment with explicit channel biases; for convolutional layers, per-kernel merger coefficients, and a low-rank Cayley transform that aligns channels by orthogonal rotation without distorting the filters. By keeping the experts frozen and optimizing only these lightweight merger parameters (equivalent to <0.4% of the network footprint), OptIMerge achieves simultaneous multi-task capabilities that rival computationally expensive joint training and decisively outperform zero-shot model soups.

translation.title: OptIMerge：基于优化的扩散模型合并
translation.abstract: 对从共享基座模型微调出的多个任务特定模型的权重进行算术合并（通常称为 model souping），已成为无需联合重训练计算开销的多任务学习流行策略。然而，当各组成模型学习到结构上分歧的特征表示时，朴素的标量权重平均常常导致严重的性能退化，产生破坏性的参数干扰。我们在一个很大程度上未被探索的场景中研究该问题：合并针对密集、像素级精确任务（如图像修复）微调的图像到图像（I2I）扩散模型。与大多数合并方法所针对的大语言模型（LLM）和文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型不同，I2I 专家模型在其卷积滤波器中编码了相互冲突的空间先验（例如各向异性运动模糊 vs. 各向同性散焦模糊），此时朴素 soup 和 LLM 风格的逐元素合并都会引入可见伪影。我们提出 OptIMerge，一个基于梯度的优化框架：OptIMerge 不依赖启发式标量，而是通过在 100-500 张图像的小集合上最小化多任务扩散损失，学习表达力强且参数高效的合并系数。OptIMerge 用架构感知的变换来参数化合并：对注意力层，采用带显式通道偏置的结构化低秩特征对齐；对卷积层，采用逐 kernel 的合并系数，以及通过正交旋转对齐通道而不扭曲滤波器的低秩 Cayley 变换。通过冻结专家模型、仅优化这些轻量合并参数（相当于网络规模的不到 0.4%），OptIMerge 实现了可与计算昂贵的联合训练相媲美的同时多任务能力，并显著优于零样本 model soup。
translation.brief: 解决微调后的 I2I 扩散模型因空间先验冲突而无法用朴素权重平均合并的问题，核心方法是基于梯度的优化框架，用架构感知的轻量合并系数（注意力低秩对齐、卷积逐 kernel 系数与 Cayley 旋转）学习合并参数。

papers.title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
papers.abstract: Language agents increasingly use persistent memory to record user preferences and procedures across sessions. We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks. We call this failure the memory trap. To study this issue, we compare behavior in sessions with and without memory across six frontier models (including Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable models and GPT-5.6). We evaluate these models in a range of settings. First, in autonomy experiments, we find that requests to skip confirmation during low-stakes coding chores lead agents to skip confirmation and verification on simulated high-stakes tasks in both coding and everyday life. We next study memories formed when users seek emotional support, or describe harm from uncritical feedback, and find these memories bias later judgments of mathematical work, arguments, and poems toward sycophancy or over-critique (respectively). Memory notes written during legitimate stale-test repairs lead agents to weaken correct tests that catch broken safeguards; these memories also increase cheating on ImpossibleBench, with larger increases for stronger Sonnet and Opus models. We show that memory traps can arise both from overgeneralizations in memory writing, and when acting on memory. These findings demonstrate that even benign interactions can lead to serious risks from memory systems, and thus motivate the need for new research into ensuring that agents preserve the scope of their memories.

translation.title: 记忆陷阱：语言智能体从良性交互中过度泛化
translation.abstract: 语言智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆来跨会话记录用户偏好和操作流程。我们表明，来自良性交互的记忆可能导致智能体在后续任务中出现不安全或不可靠的行为。我们将这种失效称为记忆陷阱。为研究该问题，我们对比了六个前沿模型（包括 Claude Sonnet、Opus、Fable 模型和 GPT-5.6）在有记忆和无记忆会话中的行为。我们在多种设置下评估这些模型。首先，在自主性实验中，我们发现要求在低风险编码杂务中跳过确认的请求，会导致智能体在编码和日常生活的模拟高风险任务中也跳过确认和验证。接着，我们研究了用户寻求情感支持或描述因不加批判的反馈而受到伤害时形成的记忆，发现这些记忆会使智能体对后续数学作业、论证和诗歌的评判偏向谄媚或过度批评（分别对应）。在合法的过时测试修复期间写下的记忆笔记会导致智能体削弱用于捕获失效防护的正确测试；这些记忆还会增加在 ImpossibleBench 上的作弊行为，且对更强的 Sonnet 和 Opus 模型增幅更大。我们表明，记忆陷阱既可能源于记忆写入时的过度泛化，也可能源于依据记忆行动时。这些发现表明，即使是良性交互也可能给记忆系统带来严重风险，因此亟需新研究来确保智能体保持记忆的适用范围。
translation.brief: 研究语言智能体持久记忆导致后续不安全行为的问题，核心方法是通过跨六个前沿模型、多场景的有/无记忆对照实验系统刻画“记忆陷阱”的成因与表现。

papers.title: SKIM: Pruning Large Language Model Agents via Selective Knowledge Informed Masking
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed under structured generation, where grammar constraints enforce output format at inference time. Whereas existing compression methods target unconstrained generation, we first identify a fundamental mismatch: under structured generation, grammar constraints reduce the model's output distribution to valid tokens, and the logits matter most at the small set of positions that decide the agent's action. Motivated by this finding, we propose SKIM (Selective Knowledge-Informed Masking), the first pruning and distillation framework for LLM agents under structured generation, with both stages guided by token role. SKIM partitions token positions into context, decision, and format categories, and this partition drives two complementary axes: (1) category-aware pruning saliency scores that preserve parameters most relevant for decision positions; and (2) an on-policy distillation objective that aligns student and teacher on valid tokens, paired with category-aware feature matching. We evaluate SKIM on tool-calling benchmarks and within multi-step agent loops, across multiple model scales and sparsity levels. SKIM consistently improves accuracy over baselines, with its superiority becoming most striking in high-sparsity regimes where conventional methods struggle, demonstrating the potential of category-aware compression for deployment-time grammar-constrained agents.

translation.title: SKIM：基于选择性知识引导掩码的 LLM 智能体剪枝
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在结构化生成下部署，即由语法约束在推理时强制输出格式。现有压缩方法针对的是无约束生成，我们首先发现一个根本性错配：在结构化生成下，语法约束将模型的输出分布缩减为合法 token，而 logits 最重要的是在决定智能体动作的少数位置上。受此启发，我们提出 SKIM（Selective Knowledge-Informed Masking），首个面向结构化生成下 LLM 智能体的剪枝与蒸馏框架，两个阶段均由 token 角色引导。SKIM 将 token 位置划分为上下文、决策和格式三类，该划分驱动两个互补方向：（1）类别感知的剪枝显著性分数，保留与决策位置最相关的参数；（2）在合法 token 上对齐学生与教师的 on-policy 蒸馏目标，并配合类别感知的特征匹配。我们在工具调用基准和多步智能体循环中，跨多个模型规模和稀疏度水平评估 SKIM。SKIM 持续优于基线的准确率，在传统方法难以应对的高稀疏度区间优势最为显著，展示了类别感知压缩对部署时语法约束智能体的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决结构化（语法约束）生成下 LLM 智能体压缩方法失效的问题，核心方法是按 token 角色（上下文/决策/格式）划分位置，据此设计类别感知的剪枝显著性分数与 on-policy 蒸馏目标。

papers.title: ACSeL: Adaptive Configuration Search for Hardware-Constrained LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Serving large language models (LLMs) under tight memory and latency service-level objectives (SLOs), including on edge devices, requires jointly selecting the model size, batch size, quantization algorithm, and mixed-precision quantization recipes. Exhaustive search over this combinatorially large space is infeasible. Unlike data-center serving, which often prioritizes throughput or generation speed, resource-constrained deployments typically set memory and latency budgets as constraints and then seek the configuration with the highest generation quality among feasible ones. To this end, we propose ACSeL, a framework that identifies configurations predicted to satisfy deployment constraints while achieving high predicted generation quality. To enable efficient quality estimation, we use Relative Model Quality Degradation (RMQD), a proxy based on the divergence between the candidate and reference models' next-token distributions over a small calibration corpus. Across the evaluated model sizes and precisions, RMQD is inexpensive to evaluate and strongly correlated with downstream benchmark performance. ACSeL combines (i) a lightweight quality surrogate that predicts RMQD directly from a configuration; (ii) Few-shot Median Calibration (FMC), which calibrates operator-profile-based latency estimates using a small number of end-to-end profiles; and (iii) a structured search algorithm BandPareto for exploring layerwise mixed-precision configurations. Experiments on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 workstation and an NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge platform show that FMC substantially improves deployment feasibility, while BandPareto + FMC achieves the highest feasibility and the lowest RMQD gaps to the best measured configurations in the evaluation set.

translation.title: ACSeL：面向硬件受限 LLM 推理的自适应配置搜索
translation.abstract: 在严格的内存和延迟服务级目标（SLO）下服务大语言模型（LLM），包括在边缘设备上，需要联合选择模型大小、批大小、量化算法和混合精度量化配方。对这个组合爆炸的空间进行穷举搜索是不可行的。与通常优先考虑吞吐量或生成速度的数据中心服务不同，资源受限的部署通常将内存和延迟预算设为约束，然后在可行配置中寻找生成质量最高的配置。为此，我们提出 ACSeL，一个识别预测满足部署约束同时达到高预测生成质量的配置的框架。为实现高效的质量估计，我们使用相对模型质量退化（RMQD），一个基于候选模型与参考模型在小校准语料上下一 token 分布散度的代理指标。在所评估的模型规模和精度上，RMQD 评估成本低且与下游基准性能强相关。ACSeL 结合：（i）直接从配置预测 RMQD 的轻量质量代理模型；（ii）少样本中位数校准（FMC），用少量端到端 profile 校准基于算子 profile 的延迟估计；（iii）用于探索逐层混合精度配置的结构化搜索算法 BandPareto。在 NVIDIA RTX A6000 工作站和 NVIDIA Jetson Thor 边缘平台上的实验表明，FMC 大幅提升部署可行性，而 BandPareto + FMC 在评估集中达到最高可行性以及与最优实测配置最小的 RMQD 差距。
translation.brief: 解决硬件受限（内存/延迟 SLO）下 LLM 部署配置组合搜索不可行的问题，核心方法是结合 RMQD 质量代理、少样本中位数校准（FMC）延迟估计与 BandPareto 混合精度结构化搜索。

papers.title: Stress Testing Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Against Covert Misalignment
papers.abstract: As LLM agents advance rapidly in autonomy, the risk of hidden objectives that bypass safety constraints becomes increasingly plausible. Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring offers a key control mechanism by reading the agent's reasoning and flagging misalignment before it materializes into action, yet its reliability depends on the realism of the red-team it is stress-tested against. Existing red-teaming efforts rely on shared templates, such as casting a side task as a prerequisite, which treat the side objective as an exogenous insertion and leave task-specific, contextually grounded evasions underexplored. We therefore ask: How robust is CoT monitoring against agents that strategically conceal misalignment? To answer this, we introduce TraceMRT, an automated Trace-level Monitor Red-Teaming framework that reframes the side task as a coherent sub-goal of the primary task and searches trace-shaping strategies whose induced trajectories complete the misaligned objective while reading as natural execution. Through black-box attacks on state-of-the-art monitors such as GPT-5.2 and Claude-4.5, we reveal substantial vulnerabilities even in top models. To counter these vulnerabilities, we propose a Bayesian Trajectory Monitoring framework, integrating global context and local segment evidence to detect covert misalignment. Empirically, our method significantly consolidates monitor robustness with 0.91 AUC and 0.74 TPR@FPR=0.05.

papers.title: What Gets Hacked in a Collaborative Reward for LLM Recommenders: The Part That Does Not Depend on the User
papers.abstract: Collaborative-filtering (CF) scores provide graded, personalized rewards for training large language model (LLM) recommenders through reinforcement learning. However, these rewards can cause exposure collapse: even though the CF model itself produces diverse top recommendations across users, an LLM optimized with its rewards concentrates on fewer items. We decompose each score into an item-mean component, the item's average CF score across user histories, and a residual component, the current user's score deviation from the average. Through controlled interventions, we identify the item-mean component as a contributor to exposure collapse. Accordingly, we propose two reward corrections: per-item centering removes each item's estimated mean score, while per-item standardization further rescales the residual using its estimated standard deviation. Experiments on two datasets with two identifier schemes show that both corrections substantially improve catalog coverage and exposure evenness. Compared with training on the uncorrected CF reward, our corrections increase the number of distinct items ranked first across users by up to $9.8\times$, while maintaining comparable ranking accuracy. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: Learning and Steering in Incomplete-Information Games
papers.abstract: In many modern multi-agent systems, a mediator seeks to influence strategic decision dynamics using only outcome-level feedback and without knowing agents' utilities. In this work, we study how a mediator can learn an unknown game and steer adaptive agents toward outcomes that maximize her utility using only trajectory feedback. The mediator knows the game form and her own objective, but not the agents' utilities. Moreover, she commits to nonnegative payments and provides recommendations and contexts, but receives only a single realized terminal outcome rather than full-information feedback. We develop halving-type algorithms that learn utility differences in normal-form games and conditional continuation-value differences in extensive-form games, achieving a sample complexity of $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ that matches worst-case lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. We then combine these learning procedures with a Lagrangian formulation in an online Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm that interleaves learning, equilibrium computation, and steering toward mediator-optimal extensive-form correlated equilibria (EFCE). With high probability, the Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm achieves a directness gap and an optimality gap of $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$, while time-average payments are of $\widetilde O(T^{-1/8})$.

papers.title: Evolver: Turning Agent Exploration into Evolving Capabilities
papers.abstract: Agent exploration produces valuable procedural knowledge, yet much of this experience remains confined to transient execution traces and is not systematically reused. We introduce Evolver, an experience-driven framework that transforms agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities without updating foundation model parameters. Built around structured Gene assets, Evolver integrates experience acquisition, retrieval, and feedback-guided evolution to support experience-conditioned execution across existing agent harnesses. We evaluate Evolver using Claude Code and Codex, two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-rebench, and GAIA. On a selected diagnostic set of 320 paired executions, Evolver improves task success from 83.13% to 87.50% (+4.38 percentage points) while reducing recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24%. Furthermore, among 265 pairs successful under both conditions, token consumption decreases by 17.57%, demonstrating efficiency benefits even when task success is preserved. These findings suggest that persistent procedural experience can improve both task effectiveness and execution efficiency, providing a practical foundation for transforming agent exploration into evolving capabilities.

papers.title: Align Before Aggregation: Basis-Consistent Federated LoRA under Heterogeneous Ranks
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) under heterogeneous client capacities is increasingly important, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with heterogeneous ranks makes it practical. Existing server-side aggregators compose local matrix updates $\Delta W_i$ from client-specific LoRA factors $(A_i,B_i)$ before aggregating them. Although these matrix updates lie in the same weight space $\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ and can be averaged directly, the LoRA factors that generate them may expressed client-specific local basis. In the typical compose--aggregate--factorize--dispatch loop, this basis inconsistency can make the rank-$r_i$ reference prefix dispatched to lower-rank clients unstable after server-side refactorization. In this work, we propose \textbf{FedAbA}, a basis-consistent federated LoRA aggregation framework for heterogeneous ranks. FedAbA first extracts each client's local basis, aligns it to the corresponding prefix of the global reference basis, and constructs a basis-consistent reconstruction of each local matrix update before aggregation. It then aggregates these reconstructions with weights that combine client data size and consistency score, followed by exact coefficient-space SVD refactorization and gauge fixing before rank-prefix dispatch. Our theoretical analysis clarifies the role of basis consistency and supports the proposed consistency-aware aggregation mechanism. Extensive experiments show that FedAbA outperforms representative federated LoRA baselines, with the largest gains under the strongest rank heterogeneity.

papers.title: Binding Paraphrased Instructions to Encountered Objects in sLLM Agents under Partial Observability
papers.abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM agents requires grounding diverse user expressions in their environments. Although RL-finetuned smaller large language model (sLLM) agents rival larger prompted LLMs on embodied tasks, their robustness to instruction paraphrases remains unclear. We introduce ALFWorld-Para to evaluate this robustness under controlled paraphrases, revealing 21-52% declines in success rates (SRs), predominantly driven by object synonyms. Despite retaining knowledge of synonym referents, agents often fail to take the corresponding objects even after observing them, exposing a gap between referential knowledge and object binding. Partial observability further complicates binding, as referents may remain unseen or have already been encountered under different labels. To address this challenge, we propose BINDIntent, a training-free framework that probabilistically binds referring expressions to observed labels using semantic proximity and estimated persistence against unseen candidates. Without additional training or LLM calls, BINDIntent improves synonym-paraphrase success of RL-finetuned sLLMs by 17.5-49.1 percentage points (pp) with only 0.4 ms of CPU overhead per step. It also raises GiGPO-7B's overall SR from 61.8% to 77.4%, surpassing a prompted 24B LLM. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 在部分可观测性下将改述指令绑定到所遇对象：面向sLLM智能体
translation.abstract: LLM智能体的可靠部署需要将多样化的用户表达落地到其环境中。尽管经过RL微调的较小大语言模型（sLLM）智能体在具身任务上可与更大的提示式LLM相媲美，但它们对指令改述的鲁棒性仍不清楚。我们引入ALFWorld-Para在受控改述下评估这种鲁棒性，发现成功率（SR）下降21-52%，主要由对象同义词驱动。尽管智能体保留了同义词指代对象的知识，但即使在观察到对象后也常常无法采取相应行动，暴露出指代知识与对象绑定之间的差距。部分可观测性进一步加剧了绑定难度，因为指代对象可能尚未被看到，或已在不同标签下被遇到过。为应对这一挑战，我们提出BINDIntent，一个免训练框架，利用语义接近度和对未见候选对象的估计持久性，以概率方式将指代表达绑定到观察到的标签上。无需额外训练或LLM调用，BINDIntent将RL微调sLLM的同义词改述成功率提升17.5-49.1个百分点（pp），每步仅增加0.4毫秒CPU开销。它还将GiGPO-7B的整体SR从61.8%提升至77.4%，超过了一个提示式24B LLM。代码和基准测试见此https URL。
translation.brief: 解决RL微调sLLM智能体在同义词改述指令下无法将指代表达绑定到已观察对象的问题，提出免训练的BINDIntent框架，基于语义接近度和估计持久性进行概率性对象绑定。

papers.title: A Gingerbread House for LLM Agents: Source-Planned Honeypots That Lure Autonomous Attackers into an Isolated Shadow
papers.abstract: LLM agents can exploit web vulnerabilities fast enough that patching may come too late. Deception against such agents has mostly lured them away from a real target that stays reachable. We study a different arrangement: an LLM defender plans a static honeypot from the application's source, and a router sends every later request of a client it confirms as an attacker, including a working exploit, to an isolated shadow copy. We compare no defence, this static plan, and an augmented configuration with a runtime LLM responder and further router rules, graded by the benchmark's own grader on the real target and, for ARTEX, also on the shadow. On the 40 critical CVE-Bench tasks the static plan cut real compromise from 26/40 to 5/40 for Claude Opus 4.8 and from 20/40 to 0/40 (31 valid runs) for the ARTEX attack framework. On 20 new tasks not used in the design, ARTEX went from 15/20 to 0/20. In about half of the deception-arm runs ARTEX's exploit succeeded on the shadow while the real target stayed intact: the defence moved a working exploit rather than stopping it, and the remaining risk lies in requests that reach the real target before confirmation. ARTEX reported a planted fake secret as genuine on 30 of the 120 deception-arm tasks, five times in a report that labelled another item a decoy. With ARTEX's real compromise at zero in both deception configurations, they did not differ significantly on the remaining outcomes, a comparison that does not isolate the responder.

translation.title: 给LLM智能体的姜饼屋：源码规划的蜜罐，将自主攻击者诱入隔离的影子环境
translation.abstract: LLM智能体利用Web漏洞的速度之快，可能使补丁来不及部署。针对此类智能体的欺骗手段大多是将其诱离一个仍然可达的真实目标。我们研究一种不同的安排：LLM防御者根据应用源码规划一个静态蜜罐，路由器将被确认为攻击者的客户端（包括可用的漏洞利用）的后续所有请求发送到一个隔离的影子副本。我们比较无防御、该静态方案以及带有运行时LLM响应器和更多路由规则的增强配置，由基准自身的评分器在真实目标上评分，对ARTEX还在影子环境上评分。在40个CVE-Bench关键任务上，静态方案将Claude Opus 4.8的真实攻陷从26/40降至5/40，将ARTEX攻击框架从20/40降至0/40（31次有效运行）。在20个设计时未使用的新任务上，ARTEX从15/20降至0/20。在约一半的欺骗组运行中，ARTEX的漏洞利用在影子环境上成功而真实目标完好无损：该防御转移了可用的漏洞利用而非阻止它，剩余风险在于确认前到达真实目标的请求。ARTEX在120个欺骗组任务中的30个上将植入的假密钥报告为真实，其中五次在同一报告中将另一项标记为诱饵。由于ARTEX在两种欺骗配置下真实攻陷均为零，它们在其余结果上无显著差异，这一比较无法单独评估响应器。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体快速利用Web漏洞导致补丁不及的问题，提出由LLM防御者基于源码规划静态蜜罐并通过路由器将攻击者请求重定向到隔离影子副本的欺骗防御方案。

papers.title: The Popular Get More Popular: Auditing Brand Bias in Generative Search
papers.abstract: The shift from traditional to generative search has fundamentally transformed online product discovery. Because conversational recommendations synthesize choices into a few direct answers, subtle systemic preferences toward specific providers can exert profound commercial impacts. In this work, we audit this phenomenon through two distinct dimensions: (i) brand popularity bias, the systematic preference for market-dominant entities over long-tail alternatives, and (ii) brand familiarity bias, the ranking advantage an entity encoded in an LLM's parametric memory holds over an unfamiliar competitor. First, evaluating commercial queries across major engines, we observe persistent brand popularity bias: dominant brands in the top quintile are cited 1.4x to 2.8x more frequently than the average brand within a sample of 1,176 top market players, already present in parametric memory that external web retrieval fails to mitigate. Second, through controlled in-context experiments holding product attributes constant, we find that substituting authentic brand signatures with unfamiliar ones significantly degrades recommendation rank. Conversely, fact-preserving content rewrites yield negligible ranking gains. Taken together, our findings demonstrate that generative search engines reinforce a ``rich-get-richer'' dynamic by favoring established market leaders and imposing a parametric barrier to entry that standard content optimization cannot overcome.

translation.title: 越受欢迎越受欢迎：生成式搜索中的品牌偏见审计
translation.abstract: 从传统搜索向生成式搜索的转变从根本上改变了在线产品发现方式。由于对话式推荐将选择综合为少数直接答案，对特定提供商的微妙系统性偏好可能产生深远的商业影响。我们通过两个维度审计这一现象：（i）品牌流行度偏见，即对市场主导实体相对于长尾替代品的系统性偏好；（ii）品牌熟悉度偏见，即LLM参数记忆中编码的实体相对于不熟悉竞争对手的排名优势。首先，评估主要引擎上的商业查询，我们观察到持续的品牌流行度偏见：在1,176个头部市场参与者样本中，前五分位的优势品牌被引用频率是平均品牌的1.4至2.8倍，这种偏见已存在于参数记忆中，外部Web检索无法缓解。其次，通过保持产品属性不变的受控上下文实验，我们发现用不熟悉的品牌签名替换真实品牌签名会显著降低推荐排名；相反，保留事实的内容改写带来的排名提升微乎其微。综合来看，我们的发现表明生成式搜索引擎通过偏袒既有市场领导者并设置标准内容优化无法逾越的参数化准入壁垒，强化了"强者愈强"的动态。
translation.brief: 解决生成式搜索中品牌偏见缺乏系统审计的问题，通过流行度与熟悉度两个维度及受控上下文实验，揭示参数记忆中品牌熟悉度对推荐排名的影响。

papers.title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
papers.abstract: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights. We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement. We evaluate four methods across harnesses, general and coding tasks. Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns. All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones. In one general-task case, reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten previously covered tasks. Most reliability gains also increase deployment cost. Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, but their benefits can change when combined. The highest-scoring agent does not yield the largest mean improvement in any of our four pools, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives. Transfer selectively preserves gains: coverage usually falls on the general-task target across both harness types and paradigms, but rises on the coding target with the outer-layer-only harness. These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions. As a constructive follow-up, EvoAudit turns these diagnostics into revisions of select, analyze, mutate, and gate, achieving the best performance.

translation.title: 表象之下：谈论智能体进化时我们忽略了什么
translation.abstract: 智能体框架进化无需更新模型权重即可实现递归自我改进（RSI）。我们考察更高的基准分数是否能带来可靠、高效且可迁移的改进。我们在多个框架、通用任务和编码任务上评估四种方法。重复评估、受控智能体扩展、组件干预和准入重放揭示了反复出现的模式。所有十六个进化后的智能体都获得了此前未覆盖的任务，同时失去了此前覆盖的任务。在一个通用任务案例中，可靠性提升5.2分，尽管失去了十个此前覆盖的任务。大多数可靠性提升也增加了部署成本。具体改动通常优于通用提醒，但其收益在组合时可能改变。得分最高的智能体在四个任务池中均未带来最大的平均改进，更严格的准入可能丢弃有用的替代方案。迁移选择性地保留收益：在两种框架类型和范式下，通用任务目标上的覆盖率通常下降，但在仅外层框架的编码目标上上升。这些发现促使我们采用保留感知的评估、经过测试的决策规则和明确的适用条件。作为建设性后续，EvoAudit将这些诊断转化为对select、analyze、mutate和gate的修订，取得了最佳性能。
translation.brief: 解决智能体框架进化中基准分数提升是否带来可靠、可迁移改进的评估问题，通过重复评估、组件干预和准入重放等诊断方法揭示进化模式的局限。

papers.title: MEMOIR: A Training-Free Memory Lifecycle for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents require memory systems that preserve useful information across sessions and retrieve it when needed. Existing systems treat these as separate problems: memories are written prospectively with static importance scores that are never revised after use. This creates two coupled failure modes: consolidation can silently destroy evidence that future queries require, while retrieval continues to favor stale memories. We propose MEMOIR (Memory Evidence via Merge-certified, Online Importance Revision), a training-free memory lifecycle that unifies judge-gated consolidation with retrospective attribution. Before compressing memory, screening gates test whether answer-relevant evidence is preserved. After each query, attribution estimates which retrieved memories supported the answer and updates their retrieval priority. A UCB-style exploration bonus additionally encourages retrieval of under-exposed memories, reducing the risk that frequently retrieved memories crowd out useful but less-seen evidence. On 1,905 deduplicated LoCoMo QA pairs, the full retrieval stack improves evidence recall@5 by 11.92 percentage points over bare cosine, with confidence-gated feedback adding 1.50 points overall without reference answers or reranker training; a deployment-unavailable oracle adds 1.84 points overall and 8.05 points on multi-hop. Judge-gated merge changes the recall of text-based evidence from 58.82% to 59.08%, reduces the active store by 1.42%, and incurs 0 observed losses in 100 independently audited merges, with a one-sided 95% upper loss-rate bound of 2.95%. Together, these results outline a practical deployment path: no additional LLM call on the online write path, with merge screening confined to periodic offline consolidation. The lifecycle reduces to one principle: attribute usefulness after use, and screen for preservation before compression.

translation.title: MEMOIR：面向长程LLM智能体的免训练记忆生命周期
translation.abstract: 长程LLM智能体需要能在会话间保留有用信息并在需要时检索的记忆系统。现有系统将这两者视为独立问题：记忆以静态重要性分数前瞻性写入，使用后不再修订。这造成两个耦合的失败模式：整合可能悄然破坏未来查询所需的证据，而检索继续偏向陈旧记忆。我们提出MEMOIR（Memory Evidence via Merge-certified, Online Importance Revision），一个免训练的记忆生命周期，将判别器把关的整合与回溯性归因统一起来。在压缩记忆前，筛选门测试与答案相关的证据是否被保留。每次查询后，归因估计哪些被检索的记忆支持了答案并更新其检索优先级。UCB风格的探索奖励还鼓励检索曝光不足的记忆，降低频繁检索的记忆挤占有用但少见证据的风险。在1,905个去重的LoCoMo QA对上，完整检索栈将证据recall@5比纯余弦相似度提升11.92个百分点，置信度门控反馈在无参考答案或重排序器训练的情况下总体再增加1.50分；部署中不可用的oracle总体增加1.84分，多跳上增加8.05分。判别器把关的合并将文本证据的召回从58.82%变为59.08%，活跃存储减少1.42%，在100次独立审计的合并中零观测损失，单侧95%损失率上界为2.95%。这些结果共同勾勒出一条实用的部署路径：在线写入路径上无额外LLM调用，合并筛选仅限于周期性离线整合。该生命周期归结为一个原则：使用后归因有用性，压缩前筛选证据保留。
translation.brief: 解决长程LLM智能体记忆系统中整合破坏证据与检索偏向陈旧记忆的耦合失败问题，提出免训练的MEMOIR生命周期，统一判别器把关的合并筛选与使用后回溯归因的在线重要性修订。

papers.title: Redacting Personal Data: A Speed and Accuracy Comparison of Regex, Presidio and Hybrid Designs
papers.abstract: Many enterprise projects now pass free text to large language models (LLMs), and that text often contains personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses and dates of birth. Once a prompt is sent, this data is copied into provider systems, application logs and observability traces. Redacting PII before the call is an obvious control, yet teams seldom have numbers on what it costs in latency or what it lets through. This paper compares four redaction designs that any LLM pipeline can adopt: a pure regular-expression (regex) redactor, Microsoft Presidio running on a spaCy model, a hybrid in which Presidio finds only person names while regex handles structured identifiers, and a fast hybrid that calls spaCy's named-entity component directly. All four share a known-entity rule, which removes the person the system already knows it is handling, and a consistent placeholder scheme, so the LLM can still tell one person from another after redaction. We evaluate the designs on a sample workflow, which we call ProfileAssist, that turns resumes into structured profiles, using 100 synthetic resumes (523 characters on average, with 900 PII values and 600 business terms that must survive). Regex ran at a 0.20 ms median but caught only 88.9% of PII, because it cannot find names that are not known in advance, such as the references listed in a resume. Presidio, hybrid and fast hybrid each caught 100% of PII and kept 100% of business terms, at median latencies of 37.59 ms, 30.23 ms and 13.48 ms. Measured against a 9,120 ms median LLM call, even the slowest option adds only 0.41% to the request. We therefore recommend the fast hybrid as a default for LLM pipelines that handle personal data, with regex kept as a safety net rather than as the only control.
