papers.title: Discovering Learning Rules that Shape Others
papers.abstract: In general-sum games, self-interested learners can reach outcomes that are poor for everyone, which has motivated methods that shape the opponent's learning. Methods like Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), which differentiates through the opponent's learning process, and Model-Free Opponent Shaping (M-FOS), which uses model-free optimisation methods for long-horizon opponent shaping, have enabled mutual cooperation and exploitation of learners. However, these methods require access to the opponent's parameters, policy, rewards or learning rule during deployment. In single-agent reinforcement learning, update rules discovered by meta-learning have achieved state-of-the-art results (e.g. DiscoRL). These rules are separate from the policy they train and read only the agent's own experience. We hereby extend this framework to general-sum settings by introducing Discovered Update Rule for Opponent Shaping (DUOS). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first method to discover an update rule for an agent in general-sum games. DUOS meta-trains the rule to maximise the agent's expected return over its lifetime, and updates an inner network using the agent's own experience. We show that our discovered rule exhibits behaviour consistent with opponent shaping without reading opponent policies or parameters, and ranks 1st in normalised mean score and 1st in self-play among tournament entrants.

translation.title: 发现能够塑造他人的学习规则
translation.abstract: 在一般和博弈中，自利的学习者可能达成对所有人都不利的结果，这促使了塑造对手学习的方法的出现。诸如 Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness（LOLA，通过对对手学习过程求导）和 Model-Free Opponent Shaping（M-FOS，使用无模型优化方法进行长时程对手塑造）等方法，已能实现相互合作并利用其他学习者。然而，这些方法在部署时需要访问对手的参数、策略、奖励或学习规则。在单智能体强化学习中，通过元学习发现的更新规则已取得最先进的结果（如 DiscoRL）。这些规则独立于其所训练的策略，且只读取智能体自身的经验。我们在此将该框架扩展到一般和博弈设定，提出了 Discovered Update Rule for Opponent Shaping（DUOS）。据我们所知，这是首个在一般和博弈中为智能体发现更新规则的方法。DUOS 通过元训练该规则以最大化智能体在其生命周期内的期望回报，并利用智能体自身经验更新一个内部网络。我们表明，所发现的规则在不读取对手策略或参数的情况下，表现出与对手塑造一致的行为，并在参赛者中归一化平均得分排名第一、自博弈排名第一。
translation.brief: 解决一般和博弈中对手塑造方法依赖对手参数或策略的问题，通过元学习仅凭自身经验发现可用于对手塑造的更新规则 DUOS。

papers.title: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
papers.abstract: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-\nu_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.

translation.title: 增强压缩 AI 智能体记忆中的局部与全局结构
translation.abstract: AI 智能体将文本存储为嵌入向量并进行大规模压缩。通常只要每个条目的最近邻在压缩后得以保留，该压缩即被接受，但智能体还会进行记忆整合、删除和比较，这些任务依赖于条目之间的远距离关系。我们用先前工作中提出的两种无标签保真度来评估这两端：10 个近邻处的局部保真度 $L$，以及记忆 30% 至 50% 范围处的全局保真度 $G$。在每段 96 字节时，重打分的二值编码达到 $L=0.97$，却将 10.1% 的段落移到了另一个主题；而使用 8 位编码的 PCA 在 $L=0.77$ 时仅移动 1.7%。重打分不改变存储的编码，因此 $G$ 不变。我们证明，在 $G$ 的取值范围内，$1-\nu_k$ 至多为远近排序违反率平方根的 2 到 2.18 倍，且该违反率与压缩的距离噪声相关（相关系数 0.979）。我们的局部感知量化（LAQ）将该界转化为 OPQ 索引码本上的合页目标函数，同时保持其字节数、旋转和搜索方式不变。据我们所知，LAQ 是首个目标函数来自远端可证明界的量化器。仅靠重构在 52 个留出实验中 0 次提升 $G$；而远近合页项在全部 52 次中均提升 $G$。LAQ 在全部 52 次实验中提升 $G$（在 13 个记忆编码器组上 $p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$），包括外部的 FinDER 记忆，在全部 12 次 Multi-Doc-2025 运行中在七个同等大小的量化器中 $G$ 最高，可扩展到一百万段落，并保持证据召回率。
translation.brief: 解决向量压缩只保留近邻结构而破坏记忆全局结构的问题，提出基于可证明远近排序违反界的局部感知量化 LAQ。

papers.title: LABBA: LLM-Assisted Behavioral Biometric Authentication
papers.abstract: Behavioral biometrics have emerged as a promising complement to traditional physiological biometrics by leveraging dynamic human characteristics. These modalities offer advantages including continuous authentication, inherent liveness detection, and greater resistance to credential theft and other spoofing attacks. However, existing systems remain limited in adaptability, contextual awareness, and semantic reasoning as they primarily rely on similarity metrics, static thresholds, or supervised classifiers. As a result, they often struggle with real-world conditions such as behavioral variability, environmental changes, contextual changes, and adversarial manipulations. To address these limitations, we systematically integrate LLM-based contextual reasoning into behavioral biometric authentication. LLMs provide capabilities in contextual inference, sequential reasoning, multimodal understanding, and adaptive decision-making. Building on these strengths, we integrate a lightweight LLM-based reasoning module with a novel phone-blowing behavioral biometric technique to develop a context-aware authentication framework. To this end, we first collect blow-acoustic signals from participants and systematically extract spectral and temporal features. These features are aggregated and converted into comparable similarity representations, using either discrete rule-based categories or continuous normalized scores, which are transformed into structured prompts through prompt engineering. We experimentally evaluate the proposed framework using blow-acoustic data collected from 50 participants under diverse behavioral and contextual conditions. The proposed framework achieves 99.46% and 99.38% authentication accuracy in the rule-based and score-based modes, respectively, outperforming its non-LLM counterpart while maintaining strong robustness under dynamic real-world conditions.

translation.title: LABBA：LLM 辅助的行为生物特征认证
translation.abstract: 行为生物特征通过利用动态人类特征，已成为传统生理生物特征的有前景的补充。这些模态具有持续认证、天然活体检测以及对凭证窃取和其他欺骗攻击更强抵抗力等优势。然而，现有系统主要依赖相似度度量、静态阈值或监督分类器，在适应性、上下文感知和语义推理方面仍然受限。因此，它们往往难以应对行为变异性、环境变化、上下文变化和对抗操纵等真实世界条件。为解决这些局限，我们系统地将基于 LLM 的上下文推理集成到行为生物特征认证中。LLM 具备上下文推断、序列推理、多模态理解和自适应决策能力。基于这些优势，我们将轻量级 LLM 推理模块与一种新颖的吹手机行为生物特征技术相结合，构建了上下文感知的认证框架。为此，我们首先收集参与者的吹气声学信号，并系统地提取频谱和时域特征。这些特征被聚合并转换为可比较的相似度表示，采用离散的基于规则的类别或连续的归一化分数，再通过提示工程转换为结构化提示。我们在 50 名参与者、多种行为和上下文条件下收集的吹气声学数据上对该框架进行了实验评估。该框架在基于规则和基于分数两种模式下分别达到 99.46% 和 99.38% 的认证准确率，优于非 LLM 对应方法，同时在动态真实世界条件下保持较强鲁棒性。
translation.brief: 解决传统行为生物特征认证缺乏上下文推理能力的问题，将 LLM 推理模块与吹手机声学行为特征结合构建上下文感知认证框架。

papers.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.

translation.title: StrataFlux：内存层次原生的低比特 LLM 推理
translation.abstract: 量化降低了大语言模型（LLM）推理的内存和带宽需求，但可能损害准确率；而卸载更高精度数据则可能使生成停滞。我们提出 StrataFlux，一个挑战这一权衡的框架，它在保留量化的内存和速度优势的同时，恢复低比特权重和键值（KV）缓存量化所损失的准确率。StrataFlux 协同设计精化表示、选择与传输，使主机内存和固态硬盘成为额外精度的有效来源。其选择性精度流式传输减少了传输量，将传输与计算重叠，并在解码步骤间复用已获取的精度，使生成无需等待每次传输。我们在专用 GPU 和统一内存平台上评估了 2-4 比特权重和 2-3 比特 KV 缓存。对于 2 比特的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 权重，StrataFlux 将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 9.46 降至 8.40，同时在 RTX 5090 上保持量化基线 95.4% 的吞吐量。使用 2 比特权重和 KV，StrataFlux 在 GPU 内存占用不变的情况下，将 Qwen3-8B 的 AIME 2024/2025 准确率从 11.0% 提升至 47.1%。在 128K 上下文下，使用 3 比特权重和 2 比特 KV 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 RTX 5090 上达到与 vLLM 的 4 比特 AWQ 权重和 8 比特 KV 相当的困惑度和速度，而 GPU 内存仅约为后者的一半。这些结果表明，GPU 常驻精度不必决定准确率上限，卸载层的延迟也不必决定解码速度。
translation.brief: 解决低比特量化损害 LLM 准确率而高精度卸载拖慢生成的问题，通过选择性精度流式传输从主机内存和 SSD 补充精度以兼顾速度与准确率。

papers.title: Information Elicitation by Ordinal Agreement
papers.abstract: Ordinal information is central to tasks ranging from conference peer review to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for large language models. In many such settings, there is no objective ground truth against which reports can be directly verified, making incentive-compatible elicitation challenging. Peer-prediction mechanisms have been designed to achieve truthful elicitation despite the lack of ground-truth verification. However, existing peer-prediction methods do not provide incentives for agents to truthfully compress rich private information (e.g. reviews) into coarser ordinal reports (e.g. rankings) requested by the mechanisms. We propose a simple ordinal peer-prediction mechanism that rewards agents based on pairwise agreement, measured by Kendall tau. Under a broad class of Bayesian Stochastically Order Consistent models---which includes classical models such as Mallows and Thurstone---we prove that truthful reporting is stochastically dominant, and strongly truthful under index-equivariant strategies. This provides robust incentives even for agents with non-linear utility functions, such as risk aversion. Our mechanism further accommodates heterogeneous agents, top-K reports, and subset assignments, where each agent is scored against one randomly drawn peer. Experiments on synthetic Mallows and Thurstone data, together with a real-data stress test on the SUSHI preference dataset, show right-shifted truthful-payment distributions and the highest normalized sensitivity among tested baselines.

translation.title: 基于序数一致性的信息引出
translation.abstract: 序数信息在从会议同行评审到面向大语言模型的基于人类反馈的强化学习等任务中至关重要。在许多此类场景中，不存在可用于直接验证报告的客观真值，使得激励相容的引出颇具挑战。同伴预测机制被设计用于在缺乏真值验证的情况下实现真实引出。然而，现有同伴预测方法无法激励智能体将丰富的私有信息（如评审意见）真实地压缩为机制所要求的更粗粒度序数报告（如排名）。我们提出一种简单的序数同伴预测机制，以 Kendall tau 度量的成对一致性为基础对智能体进行奖励。在一大类贝叶斯随机序一致模型（包括 Mallows 和 Thurstone 等经典模型）下，我们证明真实报告具有随机占优性，且在指标等变策略下是强真实的。这即使对具有非线性效用函数（如风险厌恶）的智能体也能提供稳健的激励。我们的机制还支持异质智能体、top-K 报告和子集分配，其中每个智能体仅与随机抽取的一名同伴进行评分比较。在合成 Mallows 和 Thurstone 数据上的实验，以及在 SUSHI 偏好数据集上的真实数据压力测试表明，真实报告的支付分布右移，且在所测试的基线中具有最高的归一化敏感度。
translation.brief: 解决无真值验证场景下激励智能体真实提交序数报告的问题，提出基于 Kendall tau 成对一致性的同伴预测机制并证明真实报告的随机占优性。

papers.title: CascadeFilter: Cost-Efficient Semantic Filtering with Joint Threshold Selection
papers.abstract: Semantic filtering selects records that satisfy a natural-language predicate and is an important operation in data analytics based on large language models (LLMs). Executing an expensive model on every document incurs substantial inference cost. Existing approaches reduce this cost by accepting predictions from cheaper models and forwarding uncertain records to an oracle. Task Cascades further varies document portions and operations, and provides an accuracy-guaranteed extension. However, its threshold calibration follows a prescribed adjustment sequence after cascade assembly, rather than minimizing cost over alternative combinations of stage thresholds. Motivated by this, we propose CascadeFilter, a three-stage semantic filtering method that jointly searches the thresholds for a small language model operating on extracted evidence and full documents, with unresolved records forwarded to the oracle. For a fixed cascade, we formulate threshold selection as minimizing token-aware cost subject to an oracle-relative error constraint, and select the least-cost certified configuration in a pre-specified grid. A finite-population calibration procedure bounds oracle-relative error after selection, using fixed-sequence tests on threshold tracks to allocate the multiple-testing budget. We further combine lexical and dense retrieval, reranking, and neighborhood-supported confidence to improve evidence extraction and routing. These components enhance the cascade while leaving its certification interface unchanged. Across six datasets and 13 evaluation settings, the reported results have the highest benchmark accuracy and macro-averaged F1 score in 12 settings each. These comparisons describe the reported operating points; the accuracy guarantee concerns agreement with the oracle.

translation.title: CascadeFilter：基于联合阈值选择的低成本语义过滤
translation.abstract: 语义过滤是选择满足自然语言谓词的记录的操作，是基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据分析中的重要操作。对每个文档都执行昂贵模型会产生大量推理成本。现有方法通过接受更便宜模型的预测并将不确定的记录转发给 oracle 来降低成本。Task Cascades 进一步变化文档片段和操作，并提供了精度保证的扩展。然而，其阈值校准是在级联组装之后按照预设的调整序列进行，而不是在阶段阈值的备选组合上最小化成本。受此启发，我们提出 CascadeFilter，一种三阶段语义过滤方法，联合搜索在提取的证据和完整文档上运行的小语言模型的阈值，未解决的记录转发给 oracle。对于固定级联，我们将阈值选择形式化为在 oracle 相对误差约束下最小化 token 感知成本，并在预先指定的网格中选择成本最低的经认证配置。有限总体校准程序在选择后约束 oracle 相对误差，通过对阈值轨迹的固定序列检验来分配多重检验预算。我们进一步结合词法与稠密检索、重排序以及邻域支持的置信度来改进证据提取和路由。这些组件在保持级联认证接口不变的情况下增强了级联。在六个数据集和 13 个评估设置中，所报告的结果在 12 个设置中分别取得了最高的基准准确率和宏平均 F1 分数。这些比较描述的是所报告的工作点；精度保证涉及与 oracle 的一致性。
translation.brief: 解决级联式语义过滤中各阶段阈值未联合优化导致成本偏高的问题，方法是将阈值选择形式化为带 oracle 相对误差约束的 token 感知成本最小化，并用有限总体校准提供精度保证。

papers.title: FedReason: Large Language Models as Weight-Space Meta-Aggregators for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Federated learning servers combine client models with a fixed aggregation rule, and each rule in common use is designed for one kind of heterogeneity. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that inspects the client models can choose the rule itself, without any training on the server. In FedReason, the LLM is called every ten rounds. It analyses the weights by running code in a restricted server-side sandbox, sees only the printed results, may score a few candidates on a 500-image proxy set, and submits a short Python aggregation program. The server applies the program until the next call and falls back to FedAvg whenever its output is invalid. Full weight tensors never leave the server. We evaluated FedReason with Claude Opus 5.5 on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 under Dirichlet label skew, width-heterogeneous sub-models and Byzantine clients, in 168 runs against 14 baselines. Across 12 paired label-skew runs it beat FedAvg by 1.26 percentage points on average (10 wins), and a control that spends the same per-round proxy budget on choosing among standard rules by 1.08 points. It was the strongest server-side rule on CIFAR-100 but did not beat SCAFFOLD, which changes client training. With three of ten clients malicious, it excluded all sign-flipping clients from the first round and stayed about one point below FLTrust without training a root model. Without proxy feedback, accuracy fell from 73.8% to 38.8% in one seed. A 60-round run cost 0.79 USD in API fees on average.

translation.title: FedReason：将大语言模型作为权重空间元聚合器用于异构联邦学习
translation.abstract: 联邦学习服务器以固定的聚合规则组合客户端模型，而常用的每种规则都只针对一种异构性设计。我们研究一个检查客户端模型的大语言模型（LLM）能否自行选择聚合规则，而无需在服务器端进行任何训练。在 FedReason 中，每十轮调用一次 LLM。它通过在受限的服务器端沙箱中运行代码来分析权重，只查看打印的结果，可以在一个 500 张图像的代理集上为少数候选规则打分，并提交一个简短的 Python 聚合程序。服务器应用该程序直到下一次调用，若其输出无效则回退到 FedAvg。完整权重张量从不离开服务器。我们在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上使用 ResNet-18，在 Dirichlet 标签偏斜、宽度异构子模型和拜占庭客户端条件下评估了 FedReason，共进行 168 次运行，对比 14 个基线。在 12 组配对的标签偏斜运行中，它平均比 FedAvg 高 1.26 个百分点（10 胜），比将相同每轮代理预算用于在标准规则中选择的对照高 1.08 个百分点。它是 CIFAR-100 上最强的服务器端规则，但没有超过改变客户端训练的 SCAFFOLD。在十个客户端中有三个恶意时，它从第一轮起就排除了所有符号翻转客户端，且在不训练根模型的情况下比 FLTrust 低约一个百分点。没有代理反馈时，某个种子的准确率从 73.8% 降至 38.8%。一次 60 轮运行平均花费 0.79 美元 API 费用。
translation.brief: 解决联邦学习中单一固定聚合规则无法应对多种异构性的问题，方法是让 LLM 在服务器端沙箱中分析客户端权重并动态生成聚合程序，无需服务器端训练。

papers.title: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958). We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves. More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.

translation.title: 基准即软件：Terminal-Bench 与持续基准的案例
translation.abstract: 编码智能体是迄今为止 LLM 最具经济影响的部署之一，使可靠评估日益重要。然而，即使是发布时经过仔细验证的基准也可能过时。随着模型改进，它们可能发现被现有验证器拒绝的有效解法，而评估基础设施的变更也会使任务和测试中嵌入的假设失效。我们将由此产生的缺陷累积称为基准维护债务：基准分数与其本应衡量的能力之间不断扩大的差距。我们为智能体基准引入一种持续验证工作流，结合社区报告、任务工件、智能体轨迹、自动化 oracle 检查和人工把关的修复。我们将该工作流应用于 Terminal-Bench 2.0，这是一个在发布前经过大量人工和 LM 辅助审查及红队测试的基准。我们的审计发现该基准约 30% 存在问题，并将修复结果发布为 Terminal-Bench 2.1。这些修复改变了评估结果：准确率提高了超过 10 个百分点，排行榜位置最多移动三名，尽管总体排名仍高度相关（Spearman rho = 0.958）。我们评估了资源分配如何影响基准结论。我们表明，固定的墙钟时间会显著改变智能体性能：例如，延长时限消除了 GPT 5.4 上 20 个百分点的 harness 差距，并将 GPT 5.4 mini 上 30 个百分点的差距缩小到 5 个百分点。因此，基准维护不仅是修复任务工件：资源预算是测量规范的一部分，必须与任务本身一起验证。更广泛地说，基准维护债务不只是累积的实现缺陷：我们的结果表明，随着模型改进，评估假设和资源设置都可能需要重新验证。
translation.brief: 解决基准随模型改进而过时的基准维护债务问题，方法是提出结合社区报告、自动化 oracle 检查和人工把关修复的持续验证工作流，并应用于 Terminal-Bench。

papers.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
papers.abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.

translation.title: 元访问在未来软件中的力量——以 LLM 聊天界面与 Chat AI 为例
translation.abstract: 聊天仍是许多大语言模型（LLM）任务的默认界面，即使 OpenCode 等智能体工具在编码和自动化方面表现出色。然而模型只能看到当前对话，看不到其周围的工作区。我们探索元访问——让助手获得对界面本身的结构化、经授权的视图，并提出一个层级阶梯：功能辅导；元数据、设置和偏好访问；对摘要和消息的检索、经确认的变更以及完全编排。元访问可以把聊天客户端从众多屏幕变成查找、导航、组织和操作它的单一入口，同时带来关于接地、隐私、提示注入和信任的风险。通用智能体 harness 是运行时；因为它们可以更改自身设置，元访问变得具有反身性，需要一个单独的控制平面边界。我们以 Chat AI 客户端的 Meta Chat 原型为基础。它从摘要、设置和相关消息等构建有界上下文；将引用链接到对话、主题和角色；支持经确认的、可逆的更改；提供可浏览的教程库；并推荐角色作为用户发起的对话。通过以结构化形式暴露应用状态，元访问可以将屏幕阅读器从控件描述扩展到语义工作区操作。元访问因此将聊天从观察单个对话的窗口转变为整个工作区的控制层，在不放弃用户控制的情况下将聊天扩展到智能体能力。随着助手被嵌入 IDE、仪表盘、办公套件和操作系统，AI 时代的界面应暴露其状态和能力的结构化、经授权的模型，理想情况下通过类似调试器的接口开放其现有元模型。
translation.brief: 解决聊天助手只能看到对话而看不到界面工作区的问题，方法是提出元访问——以结构化、经授权的方式向助手暴露界面状态与能力，并构建 Meta Chat 原型验证。

papers.title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
papers.abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.

translation.title: MedGraph：用图记忆维护长期医疗对话中的患者状态
translation.abstract: 跨就诊随访患者的基于 LLM 的医疗助手需要一种能在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确性的记忆。我们考察了五个记忆系统在纵向医疗对话上的错误，发现三个反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时的状态、包含他人的健康事实、或缺少答案所依赖的安全事实。我们提出 MedGraph，一种为这三种情况构建的图记忆。构建过程从每次会话中提取带日期的事实，将每个事实归因于其描述的人，并将用药、诊断和测量记录链接成保留早期状态的链。检索以链为单位对患者进行排序，在问题所问的时间点读取每条链，并附上原始对话文本；患者档案随每个问题列出所有已记录的安全事实。在 MedMemoryBench 上，MedGraph 在 GPT 和 Qwen 两种骨干下均取得最高总体准确率，分别比五个基线中最强者高 10.5 和 10.4 分，且在 GPT 设置下记忆构建和回答高效。
translation.brief: 解决长期医疗对话中记忆系统给出过时、混淆他人或缺失安全事实的患者状态问题，方法是构建带日期、按人归因并以链组织的图记忆，检索时按时间点读取并强制附上安全事实档案。

papers.title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
papers.abstract: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost.

papers.title: Cognitive Tours: Making Understanding a Deliverable in AI-Assisted Development
papers.abstract: Generative AI and agentic coding are accelerating software development, leading to concerns about technical debt. But two less visible forms of debt, cognitive debt and intent debt, are emerging as key risks to software health. Cognitive debt is the absence or erosion of a team's shared understanding where no one can confidently explain how a system works or predict the impact of a change. Intent debt is the lack of clearly articulated goals, constraints, and rationale that explain what the system is for and guide how it should evolve. This paper presents Cognitive Tours, a tool designed to mitigate and repair cognitive and intent debt. Cognitive Tours is a web-based prototype for creating and following curated paths connecting user needs, design decisions, code, tests, and open questions. AI-assisted skills help audit existing waypoints and tours for possible problems or staleness and suggest candidates for new ones; humans decide what matters, verify relationships, and construct the narrative. This division of work deliberately preserves productive friction: the sensemaking involved in selecting, explaining, and revising a tour, which is intended to foster and share understanding. Our demonstration uses a tour of Cognitive Tours itself to introduce the tool and illustrate its design decisions and interaction mechanisms. A proposed evaluation agenda concludes the paper. A demo is available at this https URL

papers.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
papers.abstract: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.

papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
papers.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
